bard.name: Singer of Heroism
bard.lore: Some bards choose to write about the grand battles and adventures that unfold in the world; they have no particular person in mind when writing these, but the grand feats that are performed by those most brave.

active.name: Inspire All
active.description: You inspire all allies (including yourself) within range for 2 turns. An inspired character has advantage on all attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks. If you are fighting against a stronger enemy than your party (might higher than your average level) the duration is doubled.

passive.name: Inspiring Songs
passive.description: At the start of each round your ally with the lowest HP is inspired by your songs; during this round they have advantage on one dice roll of their choice.

modification.name: Inspire Modification
modification.description: Inspire is now cast on all allies (including you) within range.

additionalTalents.name: Dark Horse
additionalTalents.description: Your spell modifier is doubled while your entire party is injured; additionally, all damage and healing you do is doubled while your entire party is severely injured.

additionalTalents.name: For Glory
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on all CHA checks to convince someone to join your party for an epic fight, or go to an epic quest.

bard.name: Singer of Woe
bard.lore: Some bards consider sorrow and grief to be the most powerful of emotions, and the ones worthy of their songs; tragedy and death brings great power to their songs.

active.name: Song of Sorrow
active.description: You choose an ally that is the subject of your next song; until that song is complete, all damage and healing you do is doubled while said ally is injured, and tripled while they are severely injured.
active.cooldown: cooldown until the song is finished

passive.name: Fatal Reaction
passive.description: Whenever an ally would receive fatal damage, you can use your reaction to cast a spell.

modification.name: Inspire Enhancement
modification.description: Your value of your Inspire feat is increased by two times the base value for every fallen ally on the battlefield.

additionalTalents.name: Thy Destiny
additionalTalents.description: At the end of combat, if multiple allies are dead, including the one you have your active on, only that one gets a death stack.

additionalTalents.name: Artist's Passion
additionalTalents.description: While the ally you have your active on is severely injured, you can keep casting in combat even after you run out of mana.

bard.name: Singer of Admiration
bard.lore: Some bards decide that there is one person worthy of their song, and they do their best to worship that person with their creations.

active.name: Epic Songs
active.description: (1) You choose a creature that is the grand subject of your epic songs; all your additional abilities will be targeted at said creature. (2) You increase your chosen's AP recovery by 4 for 3 turns.

passive.name: Chosen's Initiative
passive.description: Your chosen chooses every round when they want to have their turn, regardless of initiatives (first round they could go first, second one third and so on; they announce it at the end of any creature's turn, and don't have to announce it beforehand).

modification.name: Charming Enhancement
modification.description: You can use Charming to remove said value from any saving throw made by a creature against your chosen.

additionalTalents.name: Legendary Ballad
additionalTalents.description: Whenever your chosen slays a creature, you are healed for 2d6*your level HP.

additionalTalents.name: Bardic Speech
additionalTalents.description: Whenever you roll a CHA check to convince someone of anything related to your chosen, you add your proficiency to it (an additional time).

virtuoso.name: Dramatist
virtuoso.lore: Some virtuosos have a knack for turning everything into one grand play of destiny and fate; they focus their magic to turn every quest and combat into the performance of their lives.

active.name: Dramatic Twist
active.description: For the next 2 rounds, all d20 rolls that roll 10 or lower count as a 1, and all that roll 11 or higher count as a 20.

passive.name: Personal Connection
passive.description: While fighting any enemy with whom any member of the party has a personal connection (backstory, main villains, etc.), said character has advantage on all attack rolls against the enemy; if multiple allies have a connection, you are affected if possible, otherwise randomly selected.

modification.name: Powerful Song Enhancement
modification.description: The spell affected also ignores half of the target's MA.

additionalTalents.name: Protagonist
additionalTalents.description: Any CHA check that you have to roll can be considered a performance check.

additionalTalents.name: Grand Finale
additionalTalents.description: If you are the last one alive of your party in combat (only counts if you are not alone in the party), your mana costs become 0, all damage you take is halved and all damage you deal is doubled.

virtuoso.name: Fatalist
virtuoso.lore: Some virtuosos focus on the sadness and hopelessness in the world and in each person.

active.name: Reveal Hopelessness
active.description: You reveal the hopelessness in a creature; for the next 3 turns, that creature loses 1d6 AP at the start of each of their turns.

passive.name: Despair Aura
passive.description: Injured creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against your abilities.

modification.name: Fatalist Modification
modification.description: [Not specified in source document]

additionalTalents.name: Grief
additionalTalents.description: Whenever an enemy dies, their allies have disadvantage on all rolls for 1 round.

additionalTalents.name: Imminent Defeat
additionalTalents.description: If all remaining enemies are severely injured, you can roll a persuasion check against their resolve check to make them surrender, no matter the conditions.

virtuoso.name: Lone Sonata
virtuoso.lore: Some virtuosos decide that it is best if they brave the world alone.

active.name: Lone Strength
active.description: You gain temporary HP equal to 50% of your max HP for each opponent within 60 ft; the temporary HP is lost at the end of combat.

passive.name: Solo Performance
passive.description: While fighting alone, your maximum HP and mana are doubled, and your maximum AP becomes 15, and starting and recovery AP become 10.

modification.name: Unexpected Symphony Enhancement
modification.description: Unexpected Symphony damage is tripled.

additionalTalents.name: Double Trouble
additionalTalents.description: Your effects remain even while you have one ally fighting by your side.

additionalTalents.name: Tireless Efforts
additionalTalents.description: You gain stacks of exhaustion twice as hard (2 sleepless nights, 2 days without eating, etc.).

minstrel.name: Titans' Minstrel
minstrel.lore: Minstrels are known to help parties of adventurers. Titans' minstrels specialize in helping tank-oriented parties.

active.name: Protective Aura
active.description: You give all allies (except for you) within 30 ft temporary shield equal to 30% of your max HP.

passive.name: Armored Buff
passive.description: Casting a buff on an ally increases their PA and MA by 2 for 1 turn.

modification.name: Pleasant Melody Enhancement
modification.description: Its effect is doubled on injured creatures that have more max HP than you.

additionalTalents.name: Emergency Protection
additionalTalents.description: As a reaction, you can transfer all your PA and MA to an ally for 1 round (a full round from the moment of the cast).

additionalTalents.name: Titanic Might
additionalTalents.description: Casting a buff on a creature also gives them advantage on the first WILL or STR check they make.

minstrel.name: Assassins' Minstrel
minstrel.lore: Minstrels who specialize in helping damage-oriented parties.

active.name: Delayed Strike
active.description: Choose an ally within 30 ft; their next turn, all the damage they deal is reduced to 0, but the next turn all their damage is doubled.

passive.name: Mantra Damage
passive.description: Allies under the effect of a mantra deal double dice damage when their attack roll exceeds the enemy's AC by MORE than 5.

modification.name: Pleasant Melody Enhancement
modification.description: You can instead choose to add half of its value to the ally's next weapon damage.

additionalTalents.name: Power Surge
additionalTalents.description: As a reaction, you can cast a buff on an ally after they kill a creature.

additionalTalents.name: Cunning Prowess
additionalTalents.description: Casting a buff on a creature also gives them advantage on the first DEX check they make.

minstrel.name: Arcanists' Minstrel
minstrel.lore: Minstrels who specialize in helping spellcaster-oriented parties.

active.name: Arcane Enhancement
active.description: For 3 rounds, you make all your allies' (including you) damaging spells do half of the damage on a miss, if they previously did nothing, or full damage if they previously did half.

passive.name: Mana Efficiency
passive.description: Casting a buff on an ally halves their next mana/energy cost; this effect cannot save more mana than the buff costed.

modification.name: Preferred Song Enhancement
modification.description: You can reduce the number of turns you have to channel for Preferred Song, but you reduce the effect with 5% of the total HP/mana for every turn reduced from the channel.

additionalTalents.name: Aimed Magic
additionalTalents.description: As a reaction you can protect a creature from the effects of a spell one of your allies casts.

additionalTalents.name: Arcane Wits
additionalTalents.description: Casting a buff on a creature also gives them advantage on the first INT or WIS check they make.

paladin.name: Oath of Justice
paladin.lore: The most common oath amongst paladins is the oath of justice; they seek to repay good deeds and punish evil ones, in proportion to the deed.

active.name: Righteous Smite
active.description: You apply 5 times the damage of smite to an attack (after the attack roll).

passive.name: Evil Immunity
passive.description: You are immune to the first shadow/poison kind spell/damage/effect every combat.

modification.name: Divine Smite Enhancement
modification.description: Divine Smite deals double damage to evil aligned creatures, and half damage to good aligned creatures.

additionalTalents.name: Godly Rejuvenation
additionalTalents.description: Roll 1d10 at the start of each of your turns; on a 10 you recover 25% of your maximum mana.

additionalTalents.name: Divine Protection
additionalTalents.description: You are hasted while defending churches or towns protected by your god.

paladin.name: Oath of Kindness
paladin.lore: Some paladins preach that the most important quality is kindness, and seek to help others regardless of the price they pay.

active.name: Full Heal
active.description: You heal a creature to full HP; you are unable to receive any healing or temporary HP/shield for the next 3 turns.

passive.name: Protective Kindness
passive.description: Whenever a creature within 15 ft gets affected by a negative effect, you can choose to be affected instead (just the effect, not the damage of the spell).

modification.name: Healing Light Enhancement
modification.description: Now has 30 ft range, and you can consume HP to increase the pool's current value.

additionalTalents.name: Godly Rejuvenation
additionalTalents.description: Roll 1d10 at the start of each of your turns; on a 10 you recover 25% of your maximum mana.

additionalTalents.name: Divine Protection
additionalTalents.description: You are hasted while defending churches or towns protected by your god.

paladin.name: Oath of Life
paladin.lore: Some paladins decide that the spark of life is all that matters, and do everything in their power to preserve it.

active.name: Convince to Surrender
active.description: You try to convince all severely injured enemies to back down from a fight; if you succeed on a persuasion check (against their resolve check if needed) they will surrender and stop being hostile; succeeding on any enemy resets the cooldown.

passive.name: Peaceful Persuasion
passive.description: Whenever you try to convince a creature to turn to the light or back down from a fight, you add your proficiency to the roll.

modification.name: Divine Sight Enhancement
modification.description: Looking at a severely injured creature with Divine Sight allows you to see their mistakes, dreams and intentions.

additionalTalents.name: Godly Rejuvenation
additionalTalents.description: Roll 1d10 at the start of each of your turns; on a 10 you recover 25% of your maximum mana.

additionalTalents.name: Divine Protection
additionalTalents.description: You are hasted while defending churches or towns protected by your god.

paladin.name: Oath of Glory
paladin.lore: Some paladins consider that glory is the only thing worth fighting for, and that they should fight the strongest of foes.

active.name: Glorious Assault
active.description: For the next 3 turns, your actions against creatures with more max HP than you cost 1 less AP.

passive.name: Spell Save Advantage
passive.description: Whenever you successfully save yourself from a spell, you gain advantage on your next attack roll.

modification.name: Heroic Aura Enhancement
modification.description: The value is also added to weapon damage.

additionalTalents.name: Godly Rejuvenation
additionalTalents.description: Roll 1d10 at the start of each of your turns; on a 10 you recover 25% of your maximum mana.

additionalTalents.name: Divine Protection
additionalTalents.description: You are hasted while defending churches or towns protected by your god.

paladin.name: Oath of Loyalty
paladin.lore: Some paladins decide that loyalty is the most important virtue of all, and never betray anyone they call friend or ally.

active.name: Allied Focus
active.description: Select a target; all allies (except for you) have halved AP costs against it for a turn.

passive.name: Unwavering Loyalty
passive.description: You are immune to all effects that would turn you against your party - possession, charm, mad, mind control, etc.

modification.name: Healing Light Enhancement
modification.description: You consume half the amount of points you heal on injured targets (until they stop being injured) and no points on severely injured targets.

additionalTalents.name: Godly Rejuvenation
additionalTalents.description: Roll 1d10 at the start of each of your turns; on a 10 you recover 25% of your maximum mana.

additionalTalents.name: Divine Protection
additionalTalents.description: You are hasted while defending churches or towns protected by your god.

paladin.name: Oath of Destruction
paladin.lore: Some paladins (mostly those following dark gods) consider that light serves no purpose, and that destruction is their only meaning in life.

active.name: Destructive Aura
active.description: For 3 turns, all your attacks and spells that target a creature hit all creatures within 10 ft of it (except for you).

passive.name: Killing Power
passive.description: Killing a creature makes your next ability have doubled effect.

modification.name: Shadow Conversion
modification.description: All your abilities and spells that do light damage now deal shadow damage instead.

additionalTalents.name: Godly Rejuvenation
additionalTalents.description: Roll 1d10 at the start of each of your turns; on a 10 you recover 25% of your maximum mana.

additionalTalents.name: Divine Protection
additionalTalents.description: You are hasted while defending churches or towns protected by your god.

cleric.name: Servant of Life
cleric.lore: Available while serving a good god. Focused on preserving life.

active.name: Life Shield
active.description: Until the end of your next turn, none of your allies within 150 ft can drop below 1 HP.

passive.name: Emergency Healing
passive.description: Casting healing or buffing abilities on a severely injured target costs no mana and no AP.

modification.name: Mend Enhancement
modification.description: Mend can be used as a reaction, after an ally gets damaged.

additionalTalents.name: Spark of Life
additionalTalents.description: The first time a negative ability hits you, it is nullified; once per long rest; you can pray for one hour to get this feat back.

additionalTalents.name: Lifekeeper
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage and are considered proficient on all medicine and religion checks.

cleric.name: Servant of Death
cleric.lore: Available while serving an evil god. Focused on dealing death.

active.name: Death's Advantage
active.description: For the next round, you and your allies within 150 ft have advantage on attack rolls against injured targets, and deal double damage to severely injured targets.

passive.name: Efficient Destruction
passive.description: Casting abilities on severely injured opponents costs no mana and 1 AP.

modification.name: Mend/Spells Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Mend can be used on an opponent, causing them to take damage from your healing spells for 1 turn. (2) All spells have their variant (mainly doing shadow damage instead of light damage).

additionalTalents.name: Spark of Death
additionalTalents.description: The first time a negative ability you cast is resisted by an enemy (they succeed the saving throw or you miss the attack), it takes its full effect instead; once per long rest; you can pray for one hour to get this feat back.

additionalTalents.name: Deathkeeper
additionalTalents.description: You are immune from disease, but know how to extract and use/spread diseases from creatures; you also have advantage and are considered proficient on all religion checks.

cleric.name: Servant of Essence
cleric.lore: Available while serving a neutral god. Focused on balance and essence.

active.name: Essence Shield
active.description: You double the PA and MA for all allies (including you) for 2 rounds.

passive.name: Balanced Power
passive.description: While you have full HP, your attack roll and critical chance are increased by your proficiency; while you are severely injured, your mana costs are reduced to 0, and you double all healing you cast.

modification.name: Godly Aid Enhancement
modification.description: You have increased chances of succeeding when asking for information/favours related to your god's domain.

additionalTalents.name: Essence Transfer
additionalTalents.description: Whenever you are damaged, the nearest ally gets healed for half the damage received.

additionalTalents.name: Fresh Start
additionalTalents.description: The first time after a long rest that you roll an ability check you succeed it.

exorcist.name: Evocator
exorcist.lore: The exorcists who know that the answer to demonic problems are even more demons; they are very curious by nature and care more about understanding the demons than necessarily vanquishing them.

active.name: Summon Demon
active.description: You can summon demons (or their avatars) to interact with; they will chat with you, drink with you, play chess with you etc.; they will 99% of the time remain non hostile while you are, and will vanish when you become hostile; you can gather intel from them about other demons and keep tabs on the shadow realm; these meetings can grant you benefits (gaining knowledge, receiving an item as a gift, or even stat increases) but can also take their toll and give you penalties; for the most part you do not choose what demons you summon.

passive.name: Demonic Affinity
passive.description: You have advantage on saving throws that prevent unholy beings from toying with your mind and have advantage on rituals to summon creatures.

modification.name: Exorcism Enhancement
modification.description: You can use exorcism on a demon who is not inside someone to have advantage on all skill checks you do against them and give them disadvantage on all skill checks; you can use this on demons that you summon with your active without enraging them, but they will know you used it.

additionalTalents.name: Demonic Insight
additionalTalents.description: You automatically know when a creature is possessed; furthermore you know when the demon inside lies and when it speaks the truth.

additionalTalents.name: Demonic Resurrection
additionalTalents.description: If you die by a demon's hand, you can perform a ritual on it (which would kill it if it isn't already dead) to remove the death stack gained.

exorcist.name: Banisher
exorcist.lore: Exorcists who specialize in removing possessing entities from their hosts.

active.name: Enter Mind
active.description: You can enter a possessed creature's mind, in a similar fashion to the way demons do, in order to face the creature possessing someone directly and allowing you to try to free the victim from the inside; can also gain you knowledge about the person.

passive.name: Anti-Possession Aura
passive.description: Creatures within 100 ft of you (including you) have advantage on saving throws against being possessed or when trying to get rid of possession.

modification.name: Banish Curse + Exorcism Combo
modification.description: Once per day when you cast Banish Curse you can also cast Exorcism on the target, and the other way around.

additionalTalents.name: Darkness' Demise
additionalTalents.description: After removing an unholy being from a creature, you become enraged, dealing double damage to the creature for the next 3 turns.

additionalTalents.name: Back to the Light
additionalTalents.description: If you kill a possessed creature and manage to kill the possessor within a minute you can bring the creature back to life.

exorcist.name: Scorcher
exorcist.lore: Exorcists who wield fire and light as weapons against evil.

active.name: Spawn Weapons
active.description: You spawn a shortsword made of light in one hand and a fire whip in the other (they have the stats of their respective weapons of your level and you are proficient with them).

passive.name: Elemental Exploit
passive.description: After dealing light damage to a creature, you halve its fire armor for the next ability you cast on it; after you deal fire damage you halve its light armor.

modification.name: Damage Type Choice
modification.description: Your spells can do fire or light damage as you choose.

additionalTalents.name: Divine Protection
additionalTalents.description: A creature that you damage with your light sword deals only half physical damage to you while in melee range; a creature that you damage with your fire whip only deals half magical damage to you while at range; these effects last for 1 turn after the attack (and do not stack).

additionalTalents.name: Fiery Destiny
additionalTalents.description: After a hostile creature dies near you you gain the absorb status to fire for 1 turn.

druid.name: Druid of War
druid.lore: Druids who focus on combat prowess alongside their natural magic.

active.name: Elemental Resistance
active.description: For 3 turns (including casting turn) you become resistant (until the duration expires) to any type of damage that you deal (except for true).

passive.name: Weapon Proficiency
passive.description: You become proficient with shields, shortswords, daggers, maul, greataxes, handaxes, shortbows and longbows.

modification.name: Spiked Weapon Enhancement
modification.description: After casting a spell, a 'Spiked Weapon' spell of the same level affects your weapon for the rest of the turn; while Cycle of Life is active you have a Spiked Weapon spell of your maximum available level affecting all your weapons and all allies' weapons within 30 ft, and the damage is any type of damage (except true).

additionalTalents.name: Rage of War
additionalTalents.description: If you spend your entire turn only doing weapon attacks (and you started your turn with your AP recovery AP or more) you can cast one spell with no AP cost.

additionalTalents.name: Mana Drain
additionalTalents.description: 20% of the damage you deal with weapons is also gained as mana.

druid.name: Druid of Life
druid.lore: Druids who focus on healing and preserving life through nature's power.

active.name: Free Healing Spell
active.description: You can cast one healing spell from any class of a spell level that you would have available free of mana and with halved AP cost.

passive.name: Efficient Healer
passive.description: The first time you heal a creature in a turn you get halved AP cost (rounded down) on your next ability that turn.

modification.name: Nature's Embrace Enhancement
modification.description: Nature's Embrace healing is increased to 40% of the target's maximum HP; Nature's Regeneration healing is doubled.

additionalTalents.name: Urgent Sacrifice
additionalTalents.description: When you heal a creature you can choose to transfer any amount of HP and/or MANA from you to that creature.

additionalTalents.name: Eternal Life
additionalTalents.description: You can heal unconscious creatures back to life (you heal as if the creature wasn't dead); but the death stack is still applied to them and they will fight death (if appropriate) at the end of combat.

druid.name: Druid of Ambush
druid.lore: Sometimes druids are prepared to ambush their targets and take them out quickly in their forests.

active.name: Forest Invisibility
active.description: You go invisible if you are near a tree (10 ft away); you can freely move and stay invisible while you are at most 10 ft away from a tree; while combat abilities remove your invisibility, successfully hiding while within the duration will return you to this state. Lasts for 3 turns (ends at the start of your 4th turn).

passive.name: Ambush Advantage
passive.description: While in stealth/invisible your attacks and spells have advantage, and your opponents have disadvantage on saving throws against them; furthermore you also have 20% increased crit chance (you crit at 15 or above if you previously critted at 20).

modification.name: Wildwalker Enhancement
modification.description: You also add your proficiency to stealth checks made in the wilderness.

additionalTalents.name: Patient Assault
additionalTalents.description: While hiding your maximum AP becomes 15, and your AP recovery is increased by 1.

additionalTalents.name: Nature's Resilience
additionalTalents.description: While hidden you are immune to all damage and CC.

active.name: Forest Transformation
active.description: You turn into a forest animal that you have seen of might equal to your level or lower for up to 3 turns (respecting the other shapeshifting rules, HP and such).

passive.name: Poison Resistance
passive.description: While you are in humanoid form, or transformed into any forest animal, you are resistant to poison.

modification.name: Shapeshifting Enhancement
modification.description: It costs 0 AP to turn into any forest animal.

additionalTalents.name: True Shapeshift
additionalTalents.description: Your talents are applied to your shapeshifting forms as well.

additionalTalents.name: Forest Dweller
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on survival, stealth and perception checks made in the forest.

active.name: Desert Transformation
active.description: You turn into a desert animal that you have seen of might equal to your level or lower for up to 3 turns (respecting the other shapeshifting rules, HP and such).

passive.name: Heat Resistance
passive.description: While you are in humanoid form, or transformed into any desert animal, you are resistant to fire damage, and immune to downsides of exposure to high temperatures.

modification.name: Shapeshifting Enhancement
modification.description: It costs 0 AP to turn into any desert animal.

additionalTalents.name: True Shapeshift
additionalTalents.description: Your talents are applied to your shapeshifting forms as well.

additionalTalents.name: Desert Dweller
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on survival, stealth and perception checks made in the desert.

active.name: Arctic Transformation
active.description: You turn into an arctic animal that you have seen of might equal to your level or lower for up to 3 turns (respecting the other shapeshifting rules, HP and such).

passive.name: Cold Resistance
passive.description: While you are in humanoid form, or transformed into any arctic animal, you are resistant to ice damage, and immune to downsides of exposure to low temperatures.

modification.name: Shapeshifting Enhancement
modification.description: It costs 0 AP to turn into any arctic animal.

additionalTalents.name: True Shapeshift
additionalTalents.description: Your talents are applied to your shapeshifting forms as well.

additionalTalents.name: Arctic Dweller
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on survival, stealth and perception checks made in the arctic.

active.name: Underground Transformation
active.description: You turn into an underground animal that you have seen of might equal to your level or lower for up to 3 turns (respecting the other shapeshifting rules, HP and such).

passive.name: Shadow Resistance
passive.description: While you are in humanoid form, or transformed into any underground animal, you are resistant to shadow damage.

modification.name: Shapeshifting Enhancement
modification.description: It costs 0 AP to turn into any underground animal.

additionalTalents.name: True Shapeshift
additionalTalents.description: Your talents are applied to your shapeshifting forms as well.

additionalTalents.name: Underground Dweller
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on survival, stealth and perception checks made in the underground.

stormbringer.name: Earthshaker
stormbringer.lore: Stormbringers who master the destructive force of earthquakes alongside their storms.

active.name: Earthquake
active.description: You create a huge earthquake that lasts for 1 minute; for the duration, all creatures within 200 ft of you must succeed a CON saving throw at the start AND end of each of their turns or fall prone; allied creatures have advantage on the roll; you are immune to the effect.

passive.name: Quake Immunity
passive.description: You are immune to being knocked prone and to fall damage.

modification.name: Earthshake (Stormbring Alternative)
modification.description: Stormbring alternative effect: you channel an earthquake of apocalyptic force. The earthquake has a radius of 4000 feet and can be centered at any point you see or saw before and can recall. For 1 hour all creatures must succeed on CON saving throws at the start AND end of each turn or fall prone; buildings are destroyed, giant cracks form [1d6 * 100] ft deep; creatures hit by falling buildings take damage equivalent to an 8th level lightning bolt, but crushing.

additionalTalents.name: Opportunist
additionalTalents.description: You can take a reaction to use a spell (up to 3 AP in cost) on an enemy when they fall prone, similar to an attack of opportunity.

additionalTalents.name: Unfortunate Fall
additionalTalents.description: Whenever a creature rolls a 5 or less and falls prone because of you, they also drop whatever they are holding 15 ft away in a random direction.

stormbringer.name: Tidecaller
stormbringer.lore: Stormbringers who master the power of freezing tides.

active.name: Freezing Tide
active.description: You create a freezing tide to strike in a direction of your choice; the tide is 50 ft high, 80 ft wide and travels for 300 ft; all creatures in its path must succeed on a CON saving throw or become frozen for 3 turns (CON saving throw at the end of each turn to end the effect); allies have advantage on the saving throw.

passive.name: Frost Pierce
passive.description: You deal normal damage to frozen targets (not halved).

modification.name: Tidecall (Stormbring Alternative)
modification.description: Stormbring alternative: you channel a wave of apocalyptic force; width 4000 ft, height 1000 ft, travels 1000 ft per round, destroying everything in its path; CON saving throw; fail = carried with wave taking crushing damage equivalent to 8th level lightning bolt each turn; success = half damage, not carried.

additionalTalents.name: Relentless Storm
additionalTalents.description: After a creature succeeds on a saving throw against a CC ability from you, they have disadvantage on the next ability you cast on them with the same CC (does not stack).

additionalTalents.name: First Striker
additionalTalents.description: If the first thing you do in a turn is cast a combat ability, it costs 1 less AP, but you have halved speed for the rest of the turn.

stormbringer.name: Lavariser
stormbringer.lore: Stormbringers who master the destructive force of fire and lava.

active.name: Fire Storm
active.description: You start a fire storm that rages in a 60 ft radius around you for 1 minute; all creatures that start their turn within range must roll a CON saving throw; on a fail they take fire damage equal to a lightning bolt of the highest level you can currently cast, and are set burning, taking the same amount of damage at the start of their next turn; on a success they only take half damage and are not set burning; allies have advantage on the saving throw.

passive.name: Efficient Burning
passive.description: Your targeted abilities cast on burning targets have halved mana cost.

modification.name: Volcanic Eruption (Stormbring Alternative)
modification.description: Stormbring alternative: you channel your inner blaze and create a dooming inferno; affects everything within 4000 ft; all creatures must roll CON saving throw at end of each turn; on fail set on fire, take fire damage equal to 2 8th level lightning bolts at the start of their turn.

additionalTalents.name: Burning Will
additionalTalents.description: Whenever you set a creature on fire you heal for 5% of your total HP.

additionalTalents.name: Fiery Spirit
additionalTalents.description: You can add your spell modifier to all intimidation checks you make.

stormbringer.name: Lone Storm
stormbringer.lore: Some stormbringers decide they alone can do what must be done.

active.name: Lone Strength
active.description: You gain temporary HP equal to 50% of your max HP for each opponent within 60 ft; the temporary HP is lost at the end of combat.

passive.name: Solo Storm
passive.description: While fighting alone, your maximum HP and mana are doubled, and your maximum AP becomes 15, and starting and recovery AP become 10.

modification.name: Lightning Enhancement
modification.description: You deal double damage with lightning force, and all electrify effects that deal damage do double the amount.

additionalTalents.name: Double Trouble
additionalTalents.description: Your effects remain even while you have one ally fighting by your side.

additionalTalents.name: Tireless Efforts
additionalTalents.description: You gain stacks of exhaustion twice as hard (2 sleepless nights, 2 days without eating, etc.).

barbarian.name: Berserker
barbarian.lore: Barbarians who push themselves to the absolute limit in combat.

active.name: Convert HP
active.description: You convert your current HP - 1 to temporary hit points; (you remain with 1 HP and you convert the rest to temporary HP). YOUR CURRENT HP + YOUR TEMPORARY HP CAN NO LONGER EXCEED YOUR MAXIMUM HP. HAS NO COOLDOWN.

passive.name: Missing HP Damage
passive.description: You deal bonus damage with weapon attacks based on how injured you are; you deal 3 bonus damage for every 100 missing HP.

modification.name: Armor Enhancement
modification.description: All armor (PA and MA) gained through your own abilities (through Tough or Rage modification for example) is increased an additional time the base value for every 25% of your total HP missing (at 1 HP it is increased 4 times the base value).

additionalTalents.name: Unbreakable
additionalTalents.description: All healing you receive is received in the form of temporary HP.

additionalTalents.name: Fierce Manners
additionalTalents.description: When rolling intimidation or resolve checks, you can use your strength as the skill stat.

barbarian.name: Shaman
barbarian.lore: Barbarians who channel the power of totems in combat.

active.name: Summon Totem
active.description: Summon a totem of your choice at a point within 30 ft. You can use this a number of times equal to your WILL modifier. Each totem stores a spell; you can use a totem to cast its ability (paying the AP cost); your WILL is considered as your spellcasting stat.

passive.name: Reactive Totem
passive.description: Whenever a hostile creature casts a spell on you, you can summon a totem of your choice at a point of your choice within 15 ft.

modification.name: Rage Totem
modification.description: Whenever you use your rage or one of your raging attacks you summon a random totem at a point of your choice within 15 ft.

additionalTalents.name: Totemic Wrath
additionalTalents.description: Whenever you score a critical hit you can also instantly and free of costs use all totems of a type (storing the same spell).

additionalTalents.name: Shamanic Restoration
additionalTalents.description: Whenever one of your totems is destroyed within 60 ft of you, you heal for 20% of your max HP.

barbarian.name: Raider
barbarian.lore: Some barbarians focus on enduring as much damage as possible before truly going down in combat.

active.name: Defensive Stance
active.description: You halve your MS and double the AP cost of your attacks, but reduce all damage you take (after all other reductions and increases) in half; additionally, any ability that would damage you for at least 50% of your max HP is ignored altogether; lasts for 2 rounds. You can cancel the ability early.

passive.name: Raging Armor
passive.description: Whenever you get hit while raging your PA and MA increase by Y (from rage table) until the start of your next turn.

modification.name: Rage - Death Defiance
modification.description: After you die (and all Last Breath-like effects have finished triggering), you can consume a number of rage uses equal to your amount of death stacks (if available) to bring yourself back to life at initiative count 0 with 20% of your max HP; you still get a death stack, but skip the fight with death.

additionalTalents.name: Consistent Defense
additionalTalents.description: No attack or ability can crit or automatically hit (due to a natural 20) on you.

additionalTalents.name: Full Awakening
additionalTalents.description: After you are brought back from death/unconscious state you do so with full AP (max AP).

guardian.name: Battleforger
guardian.lore: Some guardians decide to hone their skills in crafting and perfecting items, in order to further aid the people they fight alongside with.

active.name: Enhance Item
active.description: You magically enhance an item - 1 hour channel; you can have at most [WIS modifier] items enhanced at a time. (1) weapon - increase base damage by [2 * proficiency]; (2) armor - increase PA and MA by [proficiency]; (3) shield - increase AC improvement by [2]; (4) food/water - make it last 20 times longer.

passive.name: Gear Protection
passive.description: Your party's gear is immune to any damage and tear, be it from bad accommodating conditions, hitting a rough object, an ooze's attack, etc.

modification.name: Embedded Weapon Enhancement
modification.description: Your weapon counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances.

additionalTalents.name: Blacksmith
additionalTalents.description: You can perform yourself armor and weapon upgrades (and won't require the smith fee to upgrade them, just the material cost).

additionalTalents.name: Smith's Knowledge
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on all checks to identify weapons and armors.

guardian.name: Royal Advisor
guardian.lore: Some guardians, especially those who are a king's personal guard, focus on their minds and the world around, in order to help their king make the best decisions.

active.name: Magic Foresight
active.description: You use your magic foresight to try and assess (roll 1d10 - DM roll, secret). (1) a person - 1: know opposite alignment; 2-3: nothing; 4-6: general alignment/behaviour; 7-10: intentions and general plan. (2) a course of action - 1: opposite result; 2-3: nothing; 4-6: general outcome; 7-10: precise and detailed outcome.

passive.name: Enhanced Investigation
passive.description: You also add your proficiency to investigation, insight and perception checks.

modification.name: Get Down Enhancement
modification.description: Can be used for any sort of attack or projectile spell.

additionalTalents.name: Final Sacrifice
additionalTalents.description: If you are the last one alive from your party, you can die and revive any dead person in the process, but you take the death stack of anyone you revive.

additionalTalents.name: Critical Thinking
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on INT and WIS ability checks while in a time constraining situation (room filling with water for example).

guardian.name: Soldier Protector
guardian.lore: Some guardians, especially those in the ranks of the army, learn to perfect their skills of helping multiple allies at once.

active.name: Damage Transfer Aura
active.description: For 1 minute, you create a 15 ft radius aura around you (that follows you); any ally that takes damage transfers half of the damage dealt (after resistance and armor reduction) to you, and you reduce it by your armor and resistances too.

passive.name: Double Cast
passive.description: If you cast a spell on an ally, you can double the mana cost to cast it on an additional ally.

modification.name: Reflective Barrier Enhancement
modification.description: Can be cast on any number of creatures besides you, but the duration becomes [1 minute / number of creatures affected] (rounded up).

additionalTalents.name: Adrenaline Rush
additionalTalents.description: While injured, you have advantage on STR and DEX ability checks.

additionalTalents.name: Wisdom of the Fallen
additionalTalents.description: Your WIS modifier is increased by its base value for every severely injured or dead ally on the battlefield (up to a maximum of 10).

conqueror.name: Knight
conqueror.lore: Knights are common folk who decide that honor, justice or other virtues are the things worth fighting for in this life; a knight takes a vow consisting generally of 3 promises to uphold 3 virtues, and they draw strength from it.

active.name: Life Steal
active.description: You heal for all the damage you deal for 3 turns.

passive.name: Proximity Armor
passive.description: Your PA and MA are increased by [your level] for every enemy creature within 10 ft of you.

modification.name: Defensive Move Enhancement
modification.description: After using 3 defensive moves consecutively (without using any offensive move in between), your next defensive move doesn't cost energy.

additionalTalents.name: Shield of Honor
additionalTalents.description: Whenever you block an attack with your shield (the attack misses due to the AC gained by the shield), you can counterattack (doesn't count as offensive move).

additionalTalents.name: Protector of the Meek
additionalTalents.description: Whenever an ally becomes severely injured in battle, you start your next turn with full AP and doubled MS.

conqueror.name: Weapon Master
conqueror.lore: Some fighters become conquerors due to their love of every weapon; they adore having the whole arsenal and using every single tool in their kit.

active.name: All-Out Attack
active.description: Can only be used at start of turn - you reduce your AC, PA, MA and SPEED to 0 until the start of your next turn, but you gain +15 to attack rolls and your attacks ignore half your enemy's PA.

passive.name: Weapon Streak
passive.description: Every consecutive attack (after the first) with a different weapon uses the modifier (STR/DEX) an additional time; this streak continues as long as you attack with a DIFFERENT weapon every time.

modification.name: Adrenaline Enhancement
modification.description: The rest of the turn after using Adrenaline, whenever an attack uses a different weapon (same rule as passive) you regain 1 AP.

additionalTalents.name: True Brawn
additionalTalents.description: Affects All Brawn; you can carry up to 10 DIFFERENT weapons and have them weigh only one.

additionalTalents.name: Loyal Customer
additionalTalents.description: When upgrading weapons at a blacksmith, you can upgrade up to 10 for the price of 1.

conqueror.name: Legend Slayer
conqueror.lore: Some fighters specialize on fighting the most giant and spectacular of foes, either for the challenge or for glory.

active.name: Legend's Bane
active.description: You choose a creature that is at least large in size, or at least 1 level of might higher than your level; you halve all damage you take from that creature for a number of turns equal to [number of levels of size beyond medium + number of levels of might beyond your level].

passive.name: Giant Slayer Damage
passive.description: You deal extra damage with each weapon attack (half for light weapons), depending on the fierceness of your enemy; [your proficiency] extra damage for each size bigger than medium, and an extra [your proficiency] for each might point bigger than your level.

modification.name: Restore Enhancement
modification.description: You increase Restore's healing by 1d10/level and the energy recovery by 10 for every level of size beyond medium and every level of might beyond your level that the strongest foe you are fighting has.

additionalTalents.name: Underdog Resilience
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on STR and CON saving throws against abilities used by creatures larger than you or with might higher than your level.

additionalTalents.name: To the Death
additionalTalents.description: While fighting a creature larger than you, or with might higher than you, you ignore all exhaustion stacks you have, and are immune to all exhaustion/fatigue type effects.

conqueror.name: Intangible Combatant
conqueror.lore: Some conquerors spend their life perfecting the art of combat and dueling; they learn how to dodge and parry every blow.

active.name: Unlimited Reactions
active.description: For the next minute, you can take as many reactions per turn as you want, but only once per action (you can't use both dodge and parry on the same attack, or use attack of opportunity multiple times on the same target).

passive.name: Intangibility Points
passive.description: At the start of each of your turns, if you haven't been damaged, you gain an intangibility point (up to 10). You lose all points when damaged by an attack requiring an attack roll or saving throw. Add intangibility points to AC, saving throws, and attack rolls. Deal increased melee weapon damage equal to [intangibility points * your proficiency].

modification.name: Defensive Move Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Parry - on a successful parry, you can choose to make a weapon attack on the foe instead of doubling their AP cost. (2) Dodge - you can change the AC increase to 10, but you also double the energy cost.

additionalTalents.name: Destiny Denial
additionalTalents.description: Effects that would automatically make an attack hit you, or make your saving throw fail cannot work on you.

additionalTalents.name: Amidst the Fray
additionalTalents.description: You are immune to the flanking effect.

conqueror.name: One Man Army
conqueror.lore: Some conquerors choose to perfect their skills of fighting the odds alone.

active.name: Lone Strength
active.description: You gain temporary HP equal to 50% of your max HP for each opponent within 60 ft; the temporary HP is lost at the end of combat.

passive.name: Solo Fighter
passive.description: While fighting alone, your maximum HP and energy are doubled, and your maximum AP becomes 15, and starting and recovery AP become 10.

modification.name: Adrenaline/Restore Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Adrenaline - you gain (and lose) 5 AP instead of 3. (2) Restore - the healing is doubled.

additionalTalents.name: Double Trouble
additionalTalents.description: Your effects remain even while you have one ally fighting by your side.

additionalTalents.name: Tireless Efforts
additionalTalents.description: You gain stacks of exhaustion twice as hard (2 sleepless nights, 2 days without eating, etc.).

shaolin.name: Monastery of Prosperity
shaolin.lore: The monastery of prosperity promotes calm, endurance, calculated and prolonged effort, both in life and in combat.

active.name: AP Doubling
active.description: For the next minute, all AP that you do not consume and is transferred over is doubled for the next turn; your maximum AP is increased by 5 during this time.

passive.name: Chakra Regeneration
passive.description: At the end of every other turn (second, fourth, etc) you regain 1 chakra point.

modification.name: Palm of Tranquility Enhancement
modification.description: Also reduces all damage the target deals by half (before resistances and armor reduction).

additionalTalents.name: Regenerating Body
additionalTalents.description: Every 10 minutes out of combat will cause you to regenerate 5% of your max HP; you can meditate for 4 hours instead of sleep, and this meditation also makes you not age or require food or water for the next day.

additionalTalents.name: Tranquil Regeneration
additionalTalents.description: At the start of your turn, if you have taken no damage for 2 rounds you heal for 20% of your max HP.

shaolin.name: Monastery of Arcana
shaolin.lore: The monastery of arcana claims that the root of existence and purpose resides in the arcana, promoting the connection with magic.

active.name: Arcane Concentration
active.description: You concentrate the essence of the arcana inside of you for 3 turns; your spell modifier increases by 10 (just for the damage part of spells), your MA is increased by [4 * your level], and you are immune to all negative effects caused by magic.

passive.name: Spell Learning
passive.description: You learn one spell at each of levels 1, 5, 9, 13, 17 from Druid, Guardian, or Sorcerer; casting uses chakra points instead of mana, and WILL as spell modifier.

modification.name: Spell Absorption Enhancement
modification.description: Whenever you absorb a spell, you will know how to cast it for the rest of the combat.

additionalTalents.name: Sign Magic
additionalTalents.description: You no longer need V(erbal) component to cast any spells.

additionalTalents.name: Soul Energy
additionalTalents.description: You can lose 25% of your max HP (take 25% as true damage, then reduce max HP by 25%), and regain all your chakra points; can only happen once per long rest, no cost.

shaolin.name: Monastery of Power
shaolin.lore: The monastery of power recognizes the power of shaolins and decided it can be enhanced; daily physical rituals and weekly meditation meant to keep minds clear in combat.

active.name: Power Surge
active.description: For the rest of your turn, you have +10 to attack rolls and each of your fist attacks cause you to regain 1 AP.

passive.name: Armor Shredder
passive.description: Every fist attack you land on a target reduces their PA by [your proficiency] until the start of your next turn.

modification.name: Martial Master Enhancement
modification.description: You can also strike 3 times with your fists for 4 AP.

additionalTalents.name: Chakra Drain
additionalTalents.description: Killing a creature restores 50% of your total chakra points; having a hostile creature die within 30 ft of you will cause the effect to trigger, but only for 25% of your total chakra points.

additionalTalents.name: Mind Resilience
additionalTalents.description: You become immune to charmed and maddened effects.

martyr.name: Master Lao
martyr.lore: Master Lao was very agile and was focused on the ferocities of his attacks to take down his foes swiftly.

active.name: Hyperactivate Focus
active.description: You hyperactivate your focus with the amount you currently have stored (be it X); for the next 2 rounds you regain X focus at the start of each turn, up to a maximum of X; you can no longer gain focus from any sources until you complete a long rest.

passive.name: Focus Burst
passive.description: The first time you damage an enemy you instantly gain 30 additional focus.

modification.name: Focused Might Enhancement
modification.description: On attacks that use a focus maneuver, Focused Might's damage is doubled (being 1/5 of the focus instead of 1/10).

additionalTalents.name: Focused Kill
additionalTalents.description: Whenever you kill a target, you gain focus equal to [enemy's max HP / 3].

additionalTalents.name: Reckless Rampage
additionalTalents.description: After killing a target, you automatically nullify the next negative ability that hits you.

martyr.name: Master Zago
martyr.lore: Master Zago learnt to control his focus to aid his ability to withstand attacks and deal with multiple foes trying to take him down.

active.name: Defensive Spin
active.description: You start spinning your weapon to deflect all incoming attacks; until the start of your next turn your AC is increased by [5]; any ability attack targeted at you that missed restores 20 focus to you (increased by Focus Deity).

passive.name: Focus Armor
passive.description: While you are not unconscious your PA and MA are increased by [your current focus / 10] (rounded up).

modification.name: Natural Defence Enhancement
modification.description: Increased by an additional [1] for every enemy within melee range of you.

additionalTalents.name: Keep Your Distance
additionalTalents.description: If you are using a weapon with reach, you can use your reaction to attack a creature that comes closer to you than your weapon's range.

additionalTalents.name: Calm Restoration
additionalTalents.description: You restore [25%] of your max HP for every 4th consecutive attack that misses you.

martyr.name: Master Tawaj
martyr.lore: Master Tawaj did not become the leader of the martyrs' group through his sheer fighting abilities, but due to his wit and wisdom.

active.name: Tactical Assessment
active.description: You quickly assess the enemy's strength and weakness, as well as your surroundings; until the end of your next turn you have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, and attack rolls against you have disadvantage.

passive.name: Mental Acuity
passive.description: Your INT and WIS are increased by [2] and you become proficient with one skill of your choice using INT and one using WIS.

modification.name: Blind Eyes Enhancement
modification.description: You can perceive things even beyond walls and other similar surfaces within your range; you gain advantage on all checks based on hearing.

additionalTalents.name: Educated Insight
additionalTalents.description: When rolling insight to figure out something about an enemy (resistances, etc.), you have advantage and can inquire after 2 things.

additionalTalents.name: Limitless Mind
additionalTalents.description: Your proficiency can increase your INT and WIS indefinitely, acting just like the stat modifier increase.

hierophant.name: [NOT IN PDF]
hierophant.lore: Hierophant specializations are not present in the source PDF.

active.name: Unknown
active.description: Not specified in source document

passive.name: Unknown
passive.description: Not specified in source document

modification.name: Unknown
modification.description: Not specified in source document

marksman.name: Ambusher
marksman.lore: Marksmen who specialize in stealth attacks.

active.name: Shadow Step
active.description: While hidden, you can 'teleport' to a point within 90 ft, remaining hidden in the process.

passive.name: Armor Pierce
passive.description: Attacking a target while hidden (in such a manner that no enemy is aware of your position even remotely), your attacks ignore that target's PA.

modification.name: Archery Training Enhancement
modification.description: When attacking while hidden (no enemy aware of your position), the effects/damage of Archery Training, High Ground and Power Shot are tripled.
modification.modifies: Archery Training / High Ground / Power Shot

additionalTalents.name: Silent Trot
additionalTalents.description: While hiding, both in and out of combat, you can move as quickly without making any more noise.

additionalTalents.name: Deathstalker
additionalTalents.description: After killing a creature, you automatically use your active (without using a charge) and become hidden.

marksman.name: Combat Marksman
marksman.lore: Marksmen who excel in close-quarters combat with ranged weapons.

active.name: Life Drain Shots
active.description: For 3 turns, you regain 50% of all damage you deal as HP.

passive.name: Melee Ranged
passive.description: When you attack a creature within 5 ft of you, you can choose to attack all creatures within 10 ft of you.

modification.name: High Ground/Ballistic Enhancement
modification.description: (1) High Ground also applies when in melee range of a creature. (2) Ballistic Shots - when shooting from melee range, you are considered to be 100 ft for Ballistic Shots.

additionalTalents.name: Quick Duck
additionalTalents.description: You are immune to attacks of opportunity.

additionalTalents.name: Opportunist
additionalTalents.description: You can shoot your bow as an attack of opportunity when someone leaves melee range of you.

marksman.name: Heavy Hitter
marksman.lore: Marksmen who focus on raw power in their shots.

active.name: Forceful Shots
active.description: For 1 minute, you can make any attack force a creature to succeed a DC [8 + 2*proficiency] STR saving throw or be pushed back [1d4 * 5] ft; if you haven't moved in the last turn, you also have advantage on the attacks.

passive.name: Stationary Damage
passive.description: You deal double modifier damage with your weapons; if you move, you deal no more modifier damage at all until the end of your turn.

modification.name: Power Shot Enhancement
modification.description: Instead of removing 5 from your attack, it instead removes 15 from your MS.

additionalTalents.name: Recovery Time
additionalTalents.description: If at the end of the turn you have not moved at all, you recover all the AP you spent reloading back.

additionalTalents.name: Perfect Aim
additionalTalents.description: You don't attack with disadvantage creatures that are half-covered.

arcane-ranger.name: Explorer Guild
arcane-ranger.lore: Some arcane rangers specialize on exploring dungeons and caves, hidden ruins, spotting and disarming traps, and surviving in the hostile dark.

active.name: Protective Dome
active.description: You create a protective dome that holds you and your party safe; it lasts 8 hours and no creature can enter it without succeeding a DC 28 CHA saving throw (can only be attempted once), and no damage can come from outside the dome; but no damage can be dealt from inside the dome to creatures outside either; the dome is 15 ft in radius; this ability cannot be cast in combat.
active.cooldown: must complete 3 long rests AFTER using

passive.name: Dungeon Expert
passive.description: You add your proficiency as flat value to all perception checks made to detect enemies, traps, and hidden doors and treasures; you also add your proficiency to all thievery, sleight of hand and arcana checks made to open chests and treasures, and to disarm traps.

modification.name: Craft Arrow Enhancement
modification.description: You can consume 2c more when crafting an arrow to add a glowing tip; the arrow will create a 15 ft radius sphere that lights the area and lasts 1 minute; you can add 20c more to enhance it to reveal all invisible creatures and traps.

additionalTalents.name: Agile Dodger
additionalTalents.description: When a trap triggers and would damage you and your allies, you can roll a d20; if you roll [14 + number of creatures affected by the trap] or more, you and the allies affected dodge the trap entirely.

additionalTalents.name: Darkness Harvest
additionalTalents.description: The first time you run out of mana (current mana < 10% of maximum), if you are in darkness you regain 30% of your maximum mana.

arcane-ranger.name: Watchers Guild
arcane-ranger.lore: Whether it is defending castles, Arcane sites or whatever other important targets, the Watchers Guild specializes on stationary defensive combat.

active.name: Root and Dominate
active.description: You root yourself, but you halve all damage you take, make all attacks with advantage and all enemies have disadvantage on saving throws against your spells; lasts for 3 turns.

passive.name: Stationary Control
passive.description: If you haven't moved since your last turn: physical damage abilities halve the enemy's speed (does not stack), and magic damage abilities halve the enemy's current range (stacks up to 2 times -> 25% of initial value).

modification.name: Surface Damage Enhancement
modification.description: If you have not moved for a round, you apply surface damage even if enemies aren't standing on a surface (of the same damage type), or double surface damage if the enemy is standing on a surface.

additionalTalents.name: Watcher's Seal
additionalTalents.description: Once a day, protect a door, lock, or similar object; doubles the object's HP and increases any saving throws needed to open/unlock/force it by [your proficiency].

additionalTalents.name: Steady Rush
additionalTalents.description: Your AP recovery is increased by 1 if you have not moved the last round.

arcane-ranger.name: Orion Guild
arcane-ranger.lore: All archers have some hunting roots. This guild focuses on hunting large, mythical monsters and taking down big, menacing targets.

active.name: Ability Block
active.description: Choose one attack or ability of your enemy (that you are aware it has); it becomes blocked; the enemy can roll a 1d10 at the start of each turn; on a 10 the ability becomes unlocked.

passive.name: Giant Slayer Saves
passive.description: You have advantage on all saving throws against targets that are giant or gargantuan.

modification.name: Arcane Explosion Enhancement
modification.description: When Arcane Explosion would hit a single target that is larger than you and has no other enemies within 10 ft, it instead exposes them; for 1 round all attacks on the creature deal [your level] extra damage.

additionalTalents.name: Resist Fate
additionalTalents.description: You are immune to enemies' effects that would make you automatically fail a die.

additionalTalents.name: Survival of Onslaught
additionalTalents.description: If an attack would kill you while you are over 50% of your HP (not injured), you instead remain at 1 HP.

hunter.name: Elusive (Wings)
hunter.lore: Elusive hunters avoid direct contact; they specialize in traps to keep enemies at bay and maintain unreachable high ground. They strongly prefer sky watchers as animal companions.

active.name: Elevated Dash
active.description: You dash to a point within 60 ft that is at least 10 ft higher than your current position, and do not trigger any attacks of opportunity in doing so.

passive.name: High Ground Advantage
passive.description: When attacking from high ground (10 ft above enemy's level) you attack with advantage.

modification.name: Trap Enhancement
modification.description: Bear trap now applies snared alongside rooted. Freeze trap: when triggered the trap affects all creatures within 10 ft of it.

additionalTalents.name: Swift Withdraw
additionalTalents.description: Attacks of opportunity against you have disadvantage.

additionalTalents.name: Still Target
additionalTalents.description: If you attack an enemy with any heavy CC (other than slow) affecting them, you attack with advantage.

hunter.name: Charging (Claws)
hunter.lore: Charging hunters get in their enemy's face with their animal companion; they forgo bows for melee weapons and use traps offensively. They strongly prefer colossus companions.

active.name: Rapid Trap Deploy
active.description: In a flash, you throw 5 traps of your choice at UNOCCUPIED points within 30 ft of you; roll a stealth check for the throw; enemies must roll a perception check against your stealth for each trap.

passive.name: Shove Master
passive.description: You have advantage on all attempts to shove enemies; additionally, if you successfully shove an enemy that is in melee range of your animal companion, it can use its reaction to attack the enemy.

modification.name: Trap Enhancement
modification.description: Explosive trap does not affect you or your animal companion. Bait trap: your animal companion's attack doubles all the damage (not just the dice), if you are within 15 ft of the enemy.

additionalTalents.name: Back to Back
additionalTalents.description: Your AC is increased by [your proficiency] while your animal companion is within 5 ft of you.

additionalTalents.name: Swift Adjustment
additionalTalents.description: If you move within 5 ft of an active trap, you can swiftly change its position up to 10 ft to an UNOCCUPIED SPACE without anyone noticing; one per round.

hunter.name: Shadow (Fangs)
hunter.lore: Shadow hunters repeatedly strike and hide, preferring prowlers for tracking foes and attacking from stealth.

active.name: Shadow Shroud
active.description: You shroud yourself and your animal companion; become INVISIBLE for up to 1 minute; attacking or using any offensive ability interrupts invisibility for 1 round; your attacks do not break the companion's invisibility, nor do its attacks break yours.

passive.name: Stealth Pierce
passive.description: When attacking from stealth, your attacks have advantage and PIERCE the enemy's armor.

modification.name: Trap Enhancement
modification.description: Blinding trap: if you are in no unblinded creature's area of sight when it triggers, you can use reaction to move 10 ft and hide (also applies to companion). Blink trap: invisible to enemies; if you enter in stealth, stealth carries over after teleportation.

additionalTalents.name: Forest's Shadow
additionalTalents.description: You become proficient with stealth (if already proficient, add another proficiency); the proficiency can now increase your skill check indefinitely, acting just like the DEX modifier.

additionalTalents.name: Silent Strike
additionalTalents.description: If you attack an enemy from stealth or invisibility, and the attack misses, your stealth is not broken.

assassin.name: Master of Stealth
assassin.lore: Assassins who perfect the art of staying hidden.

active.name: Self Buff
active.description: You cast a minstrel buff of a level you would have access to on yourself; can only trigger while invisible.

passive.name: Kill Vanish
passive.description: After killing a target, you become invisible for 1 minute; taking any combat action ends the effect early.

modification.name: Sneak Attack Enhancement
modification.description: When triggering sneak attack while invisible or hidden without any help from Swift Presence, your attack ignores an amount of PA up to [sneak attack] value.

additionalTalents.name: Untouchable
additionalTalents.description: After spending at least 3 turns in stealth/hiding, the round when you exit this state your AC is doubled.

additionalTalents.name: Close Call
additionalTalents.description: Every time a creature actively looks for you (perception check to find you) and fails, the stealth value of your current hiding increases by 2.

assassin.name: Master of Daggers
assassin.lore: Assassins who perfect the art of dagger combat.

active.name: Fan of Knives
active.description: You throw one dagger at all targets in range (must have a dagger for each); the attack automatically hits with normal damage; if sneak attack applies, completely ignores PA; if unseen blade applies, automatically critical hits (but does not lower initiative).

passive.name: Minimum Dagger Damage
passive.description: Your daggers cannot be reduced to deal less than their dice damage (including backstab and unseen blade) by PA; (half of that if the target is resistant).

modification.name: Unseen Blade Enhancement
modification.description: When hitting an opponent with both daggers, if you can use Unseen Blade on the first attack, you can use it on both and only lower your initiative once.

additionalTalents.name: Hidden Stash
additionalTalents.description: As long as you have any piece of clothing on, you are considered proficient and have advantage on all stealth checks to hide your weapons.

additionalTalents.name: Perfect Throw
additionalTalents.description: If the first thing you do in a turn is throw a dagger, you do not have disadvantage on the attack within the extended range.

assassin.name: Master of Poison
assassin.lore: Assassins who master the use of poisons.

active.name: Poison
active.description: (1) Poisoning a creature - DC [8 + 2*proficiency] CON saving throw; on fail, poison effect for a minute dealing [weapon damage] poison damage, or half on success. (2) Poisoning food/drink - affected by poison for 1 hour, taking [10%] max HP every 5 minutes, all healing reduced by 90%.

passive.name: Poison Advantage
passive.description: You attack targets that are under the poison effect with advantage.

modification.name: Sneak Attack/Unseen Blade/Cut Tongue Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Sneak attack damage can be applied as poison effect for 2 turns. (2) Unseen blade damage can be applied as poison effect for 2 turns. (3) Cut tongue - the duration of applied poison is extended to 4 turns.
modification.modifies: Sneak Attack / Unseen Blade / Cut Tongue

additionalTalents.name: Upper Hand
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on DEX and CON saving throws against creatures poisoned by you.

additionalTalents.name: Toxicologist
additionalTalents.description: You know how to craft the antidote for any poison (granted that you know what poison was used).

burglar.name: Detective
burglar.lore: Some burglars decide to make the best of their intellect and social skills.

active.name: Reliable Talent
active.description: You treat an ability check roll of your choice as a 10 (die value). At level 20, after you unlock Reliable Talent, the value of 10 is changed to 15.

passive.name: Inspiration from Success
passive.description: Successful interactions (convincing, lying, intimidating, figuring out puzzles, finding secret doors) give you a use of inspiration (advantage on one roll of your choice).

modification.name: Shrewd Eyes/Cunning Tongue Enhancement
modification.description: Shrewd Eyes applies to insight and survival checks as well; Cunning Tongue applies to investigation checks as well.

additionalTalents.name: Unrelenting Investigation
additionalTalents.description: While trying to solve a puzzle or crime, you no longer get stacks of exhaustion from lack of food or sleep for up to 3 days; resets after a long rest with no exhaustion stacks.

additionalTalents.name: Wits Showdown
additionalTalents.description: While fighting the main person behind an enigma that you solved, you have advantage on all INT, WIS and WILL saving throws.

burglar.name: Trapper
burglar.lore: Some burglars spend their life crawling through dungeons and mazes, helping parties traverse trap-ridden nightmares.

active.name: Trap Mastery
active.description: Choose to: (1) see all traps within 30 ft, (2) figure out the disarm mechanism of a complex trap, or (3) instantly succeed with no AP cost on the disarming process of a trap that you know how to disarm.

passive.name: Trap Save Share
passive.description: After rolling a saving throw to avoid a trap, you can choose to use the value for all allies within 5 ft of you too.

modification.name: Sabotage Enhancement
modification.description: You can sabotage a trap, to make it trigger automatically after a set amount of time.

additionalTalents.name: Long Haul
additionalTalents.description: You double the amount of health you can recover with short rests between long rests.

additionalTalents.name: Silent Thief
additionalTalents.description: You are considered proficient in stealth while trying to sneak in order to reach or steal treasure.

burglar.name: Liquidator
burglar.lore: Some burglars are well aware that combat is inevitable and focus on killing high priority foes.

active.name: Liquidation Strike
active.description: You do a strong attack on a target that you are in a position to backstab; roll the attack with advantage; deals 2x weapon damage or 4x main weapon (if dual wielding) and applies backstab 5 times; target must succeed CON saving throw [8+2*proficiency] or be silenced for 1 minute (repeats at end of each turn).

passive.name: Prey on the Weak
passive.description: While damaging a target with less max HP than you, you deal double backstab damage.

modification.name: Backstab Enhancement
modification.description: It can proc on both weapons on an attack.

additionalTalents.name: No Escape
additionalTalents.description: Your successful attacks of opportunity stop the target from moving with the AP (consumes 1 AP of movement).

additionalTalents.name: Agile Repositioning
additionalTalents.description: If you move around a creature (without leaving its space), you do not take attacks of opportunity from any creatures.

shadow-trickster.name: Nightcrawler
shadow-trickster.lore: Some shadow tricksters have spent their lives fighting for survival in the streets at night, learning to endure hits while in the dark.

active.name: Shadow Healing
active.description: For the next minute, whenever you proc a mark on a creature while either one of you is in darkness, heals you for 30% of your max HP.

passive.name: Glancing Blow
passive.description: All attacks that hit you, but aren't at least [your proficiency] over your AC have their damage halved (before applying resistances and armors); while in darkness the threshold becomes [2 * your proficiency].

modification.name: Shadow Strikes Enhancement
modification.description: Damage you deal with Shadow Strikes also increases your PA and MA for the same amount until the start of your next turn (stacks).

additionalTalents.name: Shadow Sight
additionalTalents.description: Your darkvision is turned into truesight (only while it is applied, so only in darkness).

additionalTalents.name: Sneaky Shadows
additionalTalents.description: Attacking a creature without darkvision, truesight or blindsight while you are both in darkness deals double damage with Shadow Strikes.

shadow-trickster.name: Engulfer
shadow-trickster.lore: Some shadow tricksters master the shadows to such an extent that they slowly suffocate and suck the life out of their foes.

active.name: Mass Shadow Application
active.description: For the next 3 turns, whenever you apply a mark you can apply it to any number of creatures within range, and when you throw a shuriken you can throw it at as many creatures within range.

passive.name: Shadow Decay
passive.description: Whenever you attack a creature while you are both in darkness, apply a stacking effect for [proficiency] turns: (1) damages creature for [proficiency * spell modifier] at start of turn, (2) lowers saving throws by [1], (3) lowers darkvision by [5 ft]; stacks up to 5 times.

modification.name: Twofold Assault + Shadow Strikes Enhancement
modification.description: When attacking a creature, if both effects proc, you reset the duration of all debuffs that are not hard CC on the creature.

additionalTalents.name: Tranquil Aim
additionalTalents.description: While you are full HP and in darkness, your attack modifier is doubled.

additionalTalents.name: Night Contracts
additionalTalents.description: While you are in darkness, you are considered proficient in all INT, WIS and CHA checks.

shadow-trickster.name: Shadow Assassin
shadow-trickster.lore: Some shadow tricksters perfect themselves to become the ultimate assassins in the shadows.

active.name: Death Mark
active.description: You mark a creature for 2 rounds; all damage you deal to the creature in that time is monitored; at the end, if that amount dealt as true damage would kill the creature, the damage is dealt as true damage.

passive.name: Weak Spot
passive.description: When your attack hits with [5] or more over the needed amount, you deal double dice damage.

modification.name: Twofold Assault Enhancement
modification.description: Converts the damage of itself and both yours and your shadow's attacks that triggered it to true damage.

additionalTalents.name: Clean Escape
additionalTalents.description: After killing a creature, you become invisible for up to 10 minutes (as long as you cast no ability that would expose you).

additionalTalents.name: Imminent Death
additionalTalents.description: If there are any enemies severely injured that you have damaged in the past round, you are immune to all negative effects.

spirit-master.name: Dark Arcanist
spirit-master.lore: Some people study the dark arts, the occult magic, and learn to wield the necessary magic to become a spirit master.

active.name: Efficient Casting
active.description: For the rest of your turn, all spirit unlocks spells cost halved AP (rounded down, can be 0) and half the mana cost.

passive.name: Spell Variety Bonus
passive.description: After casting 5 different spells in succession (if you repeat any spell, the count resets) you regain 25% of your max mana.

modification.name: Summon Spirit Enhancement
modification.description: For 2 AP you can change the type of your spirit (e.g. fire to earth); they keep their proportional HP and all buffs/debuffs.

additionalTalents.name: Careful Study
additionalTalents.description: Spells that you have learnt through your INT cannot critical fail, and automatically deal half damage even on fails (if they require a saving throw).

additionalTalents.name: Spirit Essence
additionalTalents.description: After your spirit dies, you instantly heal for 30% of its max HP; any excess HP is gained as temporary HP that lasts until the end of combat.

spirit-master.name: Heart of Darkness
spirit-master.lore: Some people are born with an innate power and knack for the darker arts, able to cast magic and summon spirits without any study.

active.name: Enrage Spirit
active.description: You enrage your spirit for 2 rounds; while enraged, your spirit has doubled SPEED, attack roll bonus, deals maximum damage with all dice damage, but also has AC, PA, and MA reduced to 0.

passive.name: Spirit AP Boost
passive.description: If you damage an injured target directly (not through energies or spirit), your spirit gains 1 bonus AP.

modification.name: Spirit Exposure Enhancement
modification.description: When a spirit's attack procs Spirit Exposure, if damage dealt is equal or greater than the target's MA/PA (the one needed), the attack ignores it altogether.

additionalTalents.name: Dangerous Power
additionalTalents.description: When you crit with a spell, the spell automatically takes the effect as if it were one level higher.

additionalTalents.name: Eager Spirit
additionalTalents.description: While your spirit is at full HP, it crits at 16 or higher.

spirit-master.name: Hunter of Spirits
spirit-master.lore: Some people defeat single-handedly a free-willed spirit from the veil, and learn to master their power.

active.name: Spirit Enhancement
active.description: You enhance your spirit, making its next targeted ability deal bonus damage equal to its missing HP.

passive.name: Spirit Damage AP
passive.description: Whenever your spirit takes damage, you gain 1 bonus AP.

modification.name: Health Transfer Enhancement
modification.description: You heal the full amount of damage your spirit takes (instead of half); additionally you can choose to gain mana instead of HP.

additionalTalents.name: Obedient Beast
