additionalTalents.description: You can control your spirit during your turn ignoring all CC affecting it (but it is still affected on its turn).

additionalTalents.name: Emergency Barrier
additionalTalents.description: When your spirit would receive a fatal blow, you can consume mana equal to the damage to deny it (the damage, not any additional effects); usable any number of times.

necromancer.name: Dead Slaver
necromancer.lore: The necromancers who focus on rising the dead, using them as means to an end.

active.name: Mass Revival / Undead Servant
active.description: CHOOSE ONE: (1) Revive all dead creatures within 60 ft for 2 rounds to fight for your side with full HP; they drop dead after 2 rounds. 4 AP, once per long rest. (2) Revive a single creature indefinitely as an undead (INT and CHA set to 1, WIS halved, uses your WILL stat, no language/spells, resistant to magic damage). 2 AP, once per long rest.

passive.name: Greater Skeleton
passive.description: Whenever a creature dies within 30 ft, use reaction to summon a greater skeleton (double damage and HP) from their corpse (costs 10% max mana; free if you killed them). Alternatively, using Mark of the Necromancer on a creature who died last round triggers the same effect without reaction or mana.

modification.name: Raise Skeleton/Reveal Dead Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Raise Skeleton - skeletons have 6 AP recovery, and only lose 15% of their max HP each turn. (2) Reveal Dead - no longer costs AP.

additionalTalents.name: Cycle of Death
additionalTalents.description: Whenever a creature is risen/revived or killed within 30 ft of you, you heal for 10% of your max HP (applies on the death of risen creatures too).

additionalTalents.name: Undead Resilience
additionalTalents.description: While you have any creatures summoned, you can contest any damage that would kill you with a WILL saving throw against DC [10 + attacker's might/level]; on success remain at 1 HP but one summoned creature dies.

necromancer.name: Demon Spawn
necromancer.lore: Some necromancers gain even more power from demonic forms, either due to demonic intervention, pacts, or demonic heritage.

active.name: Demonic Recovery
active.description: For the next minute, while in demon form you recover half the damage you deal; any excess is added as temporary HP (that expires when you exit demon form).

passive.name: Kill Extension
passive.description: Whenever you kill a creature while in demon form, you extend the duration by 1 minute and activate Demonic Departure (without changing back into human form).

modification.name: Demon Form Enhancement
modification.description: If you choose to return to human form with remaining duration, you can still go into demon form (it is not once per long rest, but rather you have a limited duration).

additionalTalents.name: Demonic Favor
additionalTalents.description: While in demon form, you can use your reaction to make a willing creature's attack roll, saving throw or ability check succeed, but they take 10% of their max HP as true damage.

additionalTalents.name: Demonic Vengeance
additionalTalents.description: If you get killed while in demon form, you deal [your max HP] as shadow damage to the killer.

necromancer.name: Shadow Mage
necromancer.lore: Some necromancers focus on the sheer destruction brought on by their spells alone.

active.name: Power Turn
active.description: Your NEXT turn you will have 18 AP; but for the rest of the combat your AP recovery is reduced to 2, and cannot be increased through any means.

passive.name: Spell-Only Mana Recovery
passive.description: At the end of each turn where you consumed all your AP and only cast spells/abilities with it (no movement, interactions, etc.) you recover mana equivalent to the cost of the highest level spell you have access to.

modification.name: Demon Form Enhancement
modification.description: The change to the spell modifier is also applied for attack rolls and spell save DC.

additionalTalents.name: Sleep of the Dead
additionalTalents.description: You regain 25% of your max mana on short rests; cannot occur more than twice between long rests.

additionalTalents.name: All Out
additionalTalents.description: For as long in combat as you only cast spells of (or at) the highest level you have access to, your spells have 10% increased crit chance (crit at 18 and above).

warlock.name: The Leviathan
warlock.lore: Warlocks who gain power from a leviathan overlord, commanding dark waters.

active.name: Deathly Waters
active.description: You create a cube with edge up to 100 ft, completely filled with dark waters that partially obscure vision (ranged attacks with disadvantage, stealth checks with advantage); you see through the water perfectly; creatures that cannot breathe underwater suffer suffocation.

passive.name: Aquatic Adaptation
passive.description: You can breathe underwater as you do on land, you gain a swimming speed equal to your movement speed.

modification.name: Dark Reserves Enhancement
modification.description: Whenever you cast an empowered spell, enemies affected also suffer from the suffocation condition for a number of turns equal to the empowered spell's level.

additionalTalents.name: Cold of the Deep
additionalTalents.description: When dealing damage while you or your enemy are at least partially underwater, you can turn the ability's damage to ice damage.

additionalTalents.name: Water Submersion
additionalTalents.description: You can completely submerge yourself underwater in any surface at least as big as a puddle.

warlock.name: The Inferno
warlock.lore: Warlocks who gain power from an infernal overlord, commanding fire.

active.name: Borrowed Fire Spell
active.description: You use one spell that deals fire damage of a level you would have access to from any class and no mana cost.

passive.name: Fire Resistance Stacking
passive.description: Every time you use an ability that deals fire damage, your fire resistance increases by 1 level for 1 round.

modification.name: Hellish Pain Enhancement
modification.description: If the procing spell of Hellish Pain deals fire damage, the target is also affected by burning for 2 rounds, with a value of the Hellish Pain's rolled value.

additionalTalents.name: Infernal Agony
additionalTalents.description: Burning targets have disadvantage on saving throws against your spells.

additionalTalents.name: Spreading Inferno
additionalTalents.description: When an enemy dies within 30 ft of you, all enemies within 10 ft of them are affected by burning of [your proficiency] for 3 rounds.

warlock.name: The Shroud
warlock.lore: Warlocks who gain power from a shroud overlord, commanding darkness and fear.

active.name: Darkness Cube
active.description: You cover a 50 ft edge cube in darkness; no creature can see anything; no ranged attacks through it; all melee attacks in it have disadvantage; ALL creatures except you that start their turn in it must succeed WILL saving throw or become frightened for a round.

passive.name: Fear Mana Recovery
passive.description: When you use a spell whose target(s) are all affected by frightened, the spell's mana cost is reduced by 50 (can go below 0, restoring mana).

modification.name: Dark Reserves Enhancement
modification.description: When using an empowered spell, you can instead force hit target(s) to make a WILL saving throw, becoming frightened for 1 round on a fail.

additionalTalents.name: Darkened Charisma
additionalTalents.description: You are considered proficient in all CHA checks made while in darkness, and have advantage on intimidation checks made in darkness.

additionalTalents.name: The Final Dark
additionalTalents.description: The first time you enter darkness in a day, your first spell cast has no cost (in or out of combat).

warlock.name: The Unknown
warlock.lore: Warlocks who gain power from an unknown, incomprehensible overlord.

active.name: Mind-Boggling Truth
active.description: You unleash the truth of the unknown; 100 ft radius sphere centered on you (follows you); ALL creatures that start their turn in it must succeed INT saving throw or skip their turn entirely (stunned effect); creatures with INT 4 or lower are immune; constructs are immune; creatures with INT 20+ have disadvantage on the saving throw.

passive.name: Unknown Enemy Advantage
passive.description: If you are fighting an enemy you have never encountered before, you have advantage on all saving throws against that enemy.

modification.name: Faith of the Cursed Enhancement
modification.description: You can roll for lore, arcana, nature and medicine checks about things you would have no way of knowing, and Faith of the Cursed is applied for the rolls.

additionalTalents.name: Unknown Fate
additionalTalents.description: You can decide to change the result of a dice (announce before roll); successful becomes failed and vice versa; only attack rolls and saving throws; [proficiency] uses per long rest.

additionalTalents.name: Embracing the Unknown
additionalTalents.description: You can willingly drop to 0 HP and be knocked unconscious without gaining a death stack; you wake when an ally revitalizes you, or after [1d8] hours on your own.

warlock.name: The Tear
warlock.lore: Warlocks who gain power from the Tear overlord, inflicting guilt and sorrow.

active.name: Guilt Stacking
active.description: All spells cast on the enemy add a stack of guilt for 1 round; a creature affected by guilt starts their turn with [1] less AP for each stack (minimum 0).

passive.name: AP Drain
passive.description: Whenever you add a negative effect on a target, that creature will start their turn with [1] less AP.

modification.name: Hellish Pain Enhancement
modification.description: A target damaged by Hellish Pain will have disadvantage on the next saving throw against your spells.

additionalTalents.name: The Grief Will Last
additionalTalents.description: After failing a saving throw, you have advantage on your next attack roll.

additionalTalents.name: The Tear's Protection
additionalTalents.description: If you are severely injured and would get hit by a damaging ability, a magic tear covers you for a minute; you are crystallized for this period; once per combat.

sorcerer.name: Study
sorcerer.lore: Many ambitious people decide to study magic in order to gain some power of their own.

active.name: Craft Spell
active.description: You craft a spell by combining 2 or more spells; the resulting spell has combined AP and mana cost, combined damage (choose damage type), highest range and AoE, and all their effects; usable up to [INT modifier] times, then you lose the ability.

passive.name: Unrestricted Learning
passive.description: You can use your INT modifier to learn spells of any level you desire (no more restrictions on the spells you learn with INT modifier).

modification.name: Sense the Arcana Enhancement
modification.description: You can sometimes sense sources of magic powers that you can absorb to learn a new spell they provide (not necessarily a sorcerer spell).

additionalTalents.name: Studied Magic
additionalTalents.description: After a long rest, you can choose to change any number of learnt spells.

additionalTalents.name: Arcane Knowledge
additionalTalents.description: When a spell is cast, you have advantage on arcana checks to find out its exact effects.

sorcerer.name: Birthright
sorcerer.lore: Some creatures are born with a very strong inclination to magic, perhaps through sheer luck, chosen by a god, or through the mysterious ways of the veil.

active.name: Arcane Shield
active.description: You shield yourself against all damage and negative effects for 2 turns; all your mana costs are doubled during this time, and you cannot concentrate or channel any other spells.

passive.name: Advanced Spell Access
passive.description: You have access to spells of a higher level than you normally would (e.g. at level 3, you have access to 3rd level spells instead of 2nd).

modification.name: Mana Burst Enhancement
modification.description: Is applied to all instances of damage of a spell (magic missiles would have all 3 missiles increased).

additionalTalents.name: Magic Takedown
additionalTalents.description: Killing a creature restores mana equal to three times the amount consumed on the ability that killed it.

additionalTalents.name: Arcane Defense
additionalTalents.description: The first time you take physical damage in a combat, you can use your MA instead.

sorcerer.name: Heritage
sorcerer.lore: When a child is born of two parents that wield magic powers, they inherit some power for themselves.

active.name: Summon Ancestor
active.description: You summon an arcane ancestor at a point you can see; for 1 minute, whenever you cast a spell you can choose to make the ancestor cast it as well (same target), for double the mana cost; you can use AP to move the ancestor.

passive.name: Efficient Upcast
passive.description: Increasing the spell of a level only costs half of the mana (the increase itself, not the spell's base cost).

modification.name: Mana Burst Enhancement
modification.description: Halves the mana cost (deals the damage of the specified mana, but only consumes half).

additionalTalents.name: Family Spell
additionalTalents.description: You can choose one spell; the first time you cast it after a short/long rest it has halved mana cost.

additionalTalents.name: Emergency Resources
additionalTalents.description: The first time you would remain with 0 or less HP after taking damage, you can convert up to 25% of your current mana into HP.

sorcerer.name: Absorption
sorcerer.lore: Sometimes, when slaying a very powerful magic being, a creature can absorb some of their magic for themselves.

active.name: Double Power
active.description: For 1 combat, you can choose to double the AP cost of any spell, and double its range, effect, damage and AoE.

passive.name: Absorbed Protection
passive.description: You gain some of the protection the creature had; your AC is increased by your proficiency.

modification.name: Empower Magic Enhancement
modification.description: You can empower any number of spells in a turn.

additionalTalents.name: Adaptable Armor
additionalTalents.description: After a long rest, you can distribute the total amount of armor you have however you want between your PA and MA.

additionalTalents.name: Cornered Beast
additionalTalents.description: You can use any spell as a reaction to someone damaging you; the spell's mana cost is multiplied by the amount of AP it costs to cast.

sorcerer.name: Treasure
sorcerer.lore: Some people manage to find objects of great power that allow them to use magic. MANDATORY: you gain a magic item as your power source; initial stats are 0; you cannot cast magic without holding it; you can't have any other magic item (considered two-handed).

active.name: Elemental Freedom
active.description: For 3 turns, your spells can do any type of magic damage.

passive.name: Channel for Power
passive.description: You can choose to channel any spell for 1 turn (the initial AP cost, but you channel until the start of your next turn) in order to double its range, AoE, or attack modifier.

modification.name: Sense the Arcana Enhancement
modification.description: You can sense sources of power that can enhance your weapon, giving it permanently increased stats (spell modifier, mana cost reduction, etc.).

additionalTalents.name: Arcane Senses
additionalTalents.description: You always know where your weapon is, and while you have it on you, you are immune to being surprised.

additionalTalents.name: Spirit Drain
additionalTalents.description: After finishing combat, you regain 10% of your max mana for each defeated opponent (regardless of who delivered the killing blows).

mindbender.name: Mind Explorer
mindbender.lore: Some mindbenders are just very curious beings; they find the mind fascinating and want to explore its abilities and limits.

active.name: Ability Lock
active.description: When an enemy uses an ability, as a reaction you can interfere with their mind; the ability gains [LOCK 11]; the creature rolls 1d6 at the start of each turn to decrease the lock's value; when 0 they can use it again.

passive.name: Mind Mastery
passive.description: After spending a minute fighting a creature, you get clear grasp on their mind; they automatically fail all saving throws against your spells (but immunities still apply).

modification.name: Mind Seeds Enhancement
modification.description: After you get 10 seeds into a creature's mind, you add [your proficiency] seeds instead of 1; additionally, Mind Seeds procs whenever you succeed on an insight check.

additionalTalents.name: Mind Navigation
additionalTalents.description: When you succeed on an insight check on an enemy, you can inquire on up to 3 things instead of 1.

additionalTalents.name: Sense Minds
additionalTalents.description: You gain blindsight of 20 ft, but that only works on conscious creatures with INT 8 or higher.

mindbender.name: Mind Enslaver
mindbender.lore: Some mindbenders desire to make their targets their puppets.

active.name: Mass Mind Control
active.description: ALL CREATURES within 100 ft ARE FORCED TO (allies cannot willingly fail) make a WIS saving throw; this round you control all creatures who failed (counts as charm effect).

passive.name: Enhanced Save DC
passive.description: You can also add your CHA modifier to your spells and abilities save DC on spells that don't deal damage.

modification.name: Mind Seeds Enhancement
modification.description: When planting a seed, you can spend up to [number of seeds on target after adding] AP as the creature to move or do non-combat actions (talk, dance, interact); creatures under this effect don't trigger attacks of opportunity and can't be walked into dangerous spaces.

additionalTalents.name: Educated Seduction
additionalTalents.description: If you succeed on an insight check on a creature, you have advantage on the next CHA based skill check on the target.

additionalTalents.name: Puppeteer
additionalTalents.description: Your AP recovery increases by 1 for every creature under your control.

mindbender.name: Mind Tormentor
mindbender.lore: Some mindbenders want to make minds unravel, and like to pick them apart thought by thought.

active.name: Unravel Mind
active.description: For the next minute, they must roll INT saving throw at the start of each turn. On fail, roll d6: 1) nothing, 2) attack with disadvantage, 3) poisoned, 4) rooted, 5) paralyzed, 6) stunned.

passive.name: Mental Distress
passive.description: Whenever you add a negative effect on a target, add a stack of 'mental distress' causing [your level] psychic damage at start of turn for up to 3 rounds; stacks up to 10 times, any new stack resets duration for all previous ones.

modification.name: Seed Explosion Enhancement
modification.description: You can choose to turn the damage into 'mental distress' damage (does not count towards stack amount).

additionalTalents.name: Arcane Unravel
additionalTalents.description: When a creature you have any seeds on dies, you regain mana as if you were to cast Mana Sap on the target.

additionalTalents.name: Torturing Insight
additionalTalents.description: After you succeed on an insight on a creature you add twice the amount of seeds the next time you deal psychic damage to them.

mindbender.name: Mind Therapist
mindbender.lore: Some mindbenders decide they want to understand the mind in order to help people heal, let go and be better.

active.name: Mind Healing
active.description: You open a creature's mind for 1 minute. Must succeed insight, then persuasion, then medicine check (DC same as examining creature). Each costs 1 AP, 1 check per turn. Must not damage the creature, and it must stay within 60 ft. If you succeed, the creature stops being hostile and agrees to a peaceful solution.

passive.name: Pacifist Advantage
passive.description: Enemies you have not damaged for 1 round have disadvantage on saving throws against spells and abilities from you that don't deal damage.

modification.name: Mind Probe Enhancement
modification.description: After succeeding on an insight check on a creature, you can also add your proficiency value to your next skill check made against the creature.

additionalTalents.name: Mediator
additionalTalents.description: You have advantage on all skill checks to calm creatures down and mediate conflict.

additionalTalents.name: One Last Grasp
additionalTalents.description: If you get killed by a creature you have not damaged for a round, you instead return to 1 HP. Cannot proc more than once per long rest.

elementalist.name: Pyromancer
elementalist.lore: Elementalists who focus on fire magic.

active.name: Reduce Fire Resistance
active.description: You make a creature that has immune or absorb to fire become resistant instead, or a creature that is resistant become normal; lasts 1 minute.

passive.name: Fire Spell Access
passive.description: You can learn any spell from any class, as long as it deals fire damage.

modification.name: Elemental Cycle/Sovereign Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Elemental Cycle also triggers after dealing fire damage 4 times to a target, but only for half damage. (2) Sovereign of the Elements becomes Sovereign of Fire - triple all damage dealt through burning; elemental cycle from fire damage deals full damage.
modification.modifies: Elemental Cycle / Sovereign of the Elements

additionalTalents.name: Eternal Fire
additionalTalents.description: Your burning effect can no longer be put out through normal means, and it resists the first magical attempt to dispel it.

additionalTalents.name: Burning Desire
additionalTalents.description: You can choose to burn your life for energy or vice versa; at end of each turn lose 20% max HP and gain 20% max mana (or reverse); stops when you run out. Once per long rest.

elementalist.name: Venomancer
elementalist.lore: Elementalists who focus on poison magic.

active.name: Reduce Poison Resistance
active.description: You make a creature that has immune or absorb to poison become resistant instead, or resistant become normal; lasts 1 minute.

passive.name: Poison Spell Access
passive.description: You can learn any spell from any class, as long as it deals poison damage.

modification.name: Elemental Cycle/Sovereign Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Elemental Cycle also triggers after dealing poison damage 4 times to a target, but only for half damage. (2) Sovereign of the Elements becomes Sovereign of Poison - double dice damage to poison/poisoned targets; elemental cycle from poison deals full damage.
modification.modifies: Elemental Cycle / Sovereign of the Elements

additionalTalents.name: Eternal Poison
additionalTalents.description: Your poison and poisoned effects can no longer be put out through normal means, and resist the first magical attempt to dispel.

additionalTalents.name: Poisoned Desire
additionalTalents.description: At the start of each round choose: poison your health (no HP/temp HP/shields, but halved mana costs); poison your mind (disadvantage on spell attacks, creatures have advantage on saves, but halve all damage received); or neither.

elementalist.name: Hydromancer
elementalist.lore: Elementalists who focus on ice magic.

active.name: Reduce Ice Resistance
active.description: You make a creature that has immune or absorb to ice become resistant instead, or resistant become normal; lasts 1 minute.

passive.name: Ice Spell Access
passive.description: You can learn any spell from any class, as long as it deals ice damage.

modification.name: Elemental Cycle/Sovereign Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Elemental Cycle also triggers after dealing ice damage 4 times, but only half damage. (2) Sovereign of Ice - triple all damage dealt when creature reaches 0 MS; elemental cycle from ice deals full damage.
modification.modifies: Elemental Cycle / Sovereign of the Elements

additionalTalents.name: Eternal Chill
additionalTalents.description: Your chilling effect can no longer be put out through normal means, and resists the first magical attempt to dispel.

additionalTalents.name: Icy Desire
additionalTalents.description: You can freeze your life for energy or vice versa; while active you cannot use mana, but you cannot take damage either; can only start and end at the start of a turn.

elementalist.name: Electromancer
elementalist.lore: Elementalists who focus on lightning magic.

active.name: Reduce Lightning Resistance
active.description: You make a creature that has immune or absorb to lightning become resistant instead, or resistant become normal; lasts 1 minute.

passive.name: Lightning Spell Access
passive.description: You can learn any spell from any class, as long as it deals lightning damage.

modification.name: Elemental Cycle/Sovereign Enhancement
modification.description: (1) Elemental Cycle also triggers after dealing lightning damage 4 times, but only half damage. (2) Sovereign of Lightning - triple all damage through lightning damage increase (from path); elemental cycle from lightning deals full damage.
modification.modifies: Elemental Cycle / Sovereign of the Elements

additionalTalents.name: Eternal Lightning
additionalTalents.description: Your stunned, shocked and AP reduction effects can no longer be put out through normal means, and resist the first magical attempt to dispel.

additionalTalents.name: Electric Desire
additionalTalents.description: Overload mana: gain mana equal to 3x missing HP, but excess mana consumed over amount gained also dealt as true damage. OR Overload HP: gain temp HP equal to 25% missing mana, but actual HP damage drains 4x that amount of mana.

elementalist.name: Master of the Elements
elementalist.lore: Elementalists who choose to master all elements rather than specialize.

active.name: Shred Magic Armor
active.description: You decrease a creature's magic armor by [your proficiency * your INT modifier]; lasts 1 minute.

passive.name: Elemental Rotation
passive.description: Whenever you cast an elemental spell, roll 1d4 for a random element; if your next spell matches the previous spell's element, it costs 1 more AP; if it matches the die roll, it costs 1 less AP.

modification.name: Elemental Path Enhancement
modification.description: You have all elemental paths available.

additionalTalents.name: Eternal Power
additionalTalents.description: You can consume 1 AP and 5% of your max mana to remove 1 negative effect from you (even while under hard CC), and you are immune to the first negative effect (resets at long rest).

additionalTalents.name: Masterful Desire
additionalTalents.description: After Elemental Cycle activates, choose for 1 round: spells cost HP instead of mana (cost reduced to 25%); OR damage is dealt directly to mana pool but is doubled.

runekeeper.name: Keeper of the Elements
runekeeper.lore: Runekeepers who channel elemental magic through their runes.

active.name: Elemental Spell Cast
active.description: You can cast an elementalist spell of a level you would have access to; this resets whenever you refresh the use of one of your runes; WIS is your spell modifier.

passive.name: Elemental Damage Choice
passive.description: After using one of your runes, all your abilities deal any type of elemental damage (fire, ice, lightning, poison) of your choice until the end of your next turn.

modification.name: Rune Damage Enhancement
modification.description: Your poison oil and fire rune can deal any type of magic damage.

additionalTalents.name: Elemental Armor
additionalTalents.description: After dealing elemental damage with an ability, you add your base PA to your MA and your base MA to your PA for the next attack (stacks).

additionalTalents.name: Elemental Overload
additionalTalents.description: After dealing damage of each elemental type your next ability costs 0 AP (if you choose to move you can move for 3 AP).

runekeeper.name: Keeper of Nature
runekeeper.lore: Runekeepers who draw power from nature for healing and protection.

active.name: Nature's Cleansing
active.description: You remove ALL negative effects from a living creature (including yourself); you can cast this even while under CC.

passive.name: Potion Mastery
passive.description: Potions and medicine have double effect on you and you become resistant to poison and disease.

modification.name: Oil/Restoration Enhancement
modification.description: When crafting an oil that deals damage you can choose any type of damage; your restoration mutation takes place whenever a hostile creature dies around you (60 ft); this cannot occur more than 3 times per day.

additionalTalents.name: Gatherer
additionalTalents.description: You can find resources that no one else can find; you can find more ingredients faster.

additionalTalents.name: Nature's Protegee
additionalTalents.description: After your restoration activates, you use Nature's Cleansing, or you take poison damage from a hostile creature directly, you become resistant to damage until the end of your next turn.

runekeeper.name: Keeper of Steel
runekeeper.lore: Runekeepers who focus on physical combat enhancement through runes.

active.name: Obliterate
active.description: Apply it to an attack that hits; target becomes normal to physical damage and has its PA reduced to 0 for a turn.

passive.name: Power Rune Pierce
passive.description: After using power rune (directly or through modifications) your next attack ignores resistances to physical/silver.

modification.name: Rune + Power Rune Combo
modification.description: After using a rune on a target, your next attack on said target will automatically have the power rune's damage active (without increase in attack roll or conversion to true damage).

additionalTalents.name: Deflection
additionalTalents.description: When attacked by a steel weapon/object (includes steel-headed arrows) you can roll a DEX saving throw contesting the attack roll; if you roll higher you deflect the attack, taking no damage.

additionalTalents.name: Steel Crafter
additionalTalents.description: You can create/upgrade steel weapons for half the cost (the cost that you would sell them for).

tormentor.name: Soul Keeper
tormentor.lore: Tormentors who can interact with the spectral realm through their weapons.

active.name: Spectral Weapons
active.description: Your weapons partially enter the spectral realm for 1 turn/spirit you see; while active, weapons can deal spectral damage. If you kill a creature with a spirit while dealing spectral damage, choose the spirit's fate: absorb it (+1 permanent essence drain damage), release it (cleanse one negative effect + heal 50% max HP), or let it roam (restore 2 curse uses).

passive.name: Spirit Sight
passive.description: Your eyes turn bright green; you can see spirits for as much as you have darkvision; when rolling any check to interact with spirits you are considered proficient and use WIS modifier.

modification.name: Curse + Spectral Explosion
modification.description: Whenever you cast a curse, you jump in and out of the spectral plane and cast a spectral explosion; all creatures within 10 ft must roll DEX saving throw; fail: [2*WIS + 35 + 2d12] spectral damage; success: half. Damage increases at levels 9, 13, 19.

additionalTalents.name: Spectral Flow
additionalTalents.description: After you cast a curse you can dash (while in spectral realm, being immune to damage) for 30 ft in a direction.

additionalTalents.name: Spirit Meditation
additionalTalents.description: If a spirit willingly accepts to meditate with you, you can enter a deep meditative state for one hour and be granted the effect of a long rest (once per long rest).

tormentor.name: Arcane Tormentor
tormentor.lore: Tormentors who enhance their hunting with arcane ranger abilities.

active.name: Maximum Potential
active.description: For 1 minute your MS is doubled while moving towards unholy creatures; after attacking with ranged weapon you can automatically dash 15 ft (immune to damage while dashing); your normal bolts are automatically considered silver.

passive.name: Magical Bolts
passive.description: When you shoot a bolt you can choose to make it magical, converting all its damage to your essence drain's type damage.

modification.name: Curse Slot Spell Cast
modification.description: You can use a curse slot to cast an arcane ranger spell of a level that you would have access to.

additionalTalents.name: Quick Reflexes
additionalTalents.description: You can use your reaction to make an 'attack of opportunity' with your ranged weapon on any creature that moves in or out of your normal range.

additionalTalents.name: Powershot
additionalTalents.description: When attacking an unholy creature that is within melee range with your ranged weapon, force the creature to make a STR saving throw or be pushed back 1d4 * 10 feet.

tormentor.name: Blood Hunter
tormentor.lore: Tormentors who feed on the blood of their enemies to gain power.

active.name: Blood Advantage
active.description: For 1 minute, you attack targets that you made bleed (damaged with physical weapons) with advantage.

passive.name: Blood Absorption
passive.description: Whenever you damage a non-construct creature with blood using physical weapons, you absorb some blood; after absorbing blood 10 times you become enraged, dealing double damage the upcoming turns.

modification.name: Power Absorption Enhancement
modification.description: While you have any power absorption feat active, you can choose to absorb blood to heal instead (10% of max HP); no longer applies to the passive.

additionalTalents.name: Blood Sucker
additionalTalents.description: You can absorb unholy creatures multiple times; every time (out of combat only) you heal for 50% of your max HP.

additionalTalents.name: Blood March
additionalTalents.description: You have doubled MS while moving straight towards creatures that you caused to bleed.

active.name: Soul Transfer
active.description: You can revive a being who recently died and fight death in its stead (if you do this after they lost the death fight you automatically get a death stack).

passive.name: Death Defiance
passive.description: When you would die/fall unconscious, you instead return to full life (takes place after Last Breath) but take 25% of your max HP as true damage at the end of each turn and suffer from the decaying status until you or an ally kills a hostile creature or combat ends.

modification.name: Spectral Plane Enhancement
modification.description: While in spectral plane you become the death of your foes; you gain specific abilities that death has based on your death stacks (the more times you have died and defeated death the more abilities you gain).

additionalTalents.name: Spectral Menace
additionalTalents.description: While in the spectral realm you are immune to almost all negative effects.

additionalTalents.name: Death Harvest
additionalTalents.description: After a creature dies near you (30 ft), you automatically hit (attack roll) your next ability.

phantom.name: Explorer
phantom.lore: Phantoms who explore the boundary between the mortal and spectral realms.

active.name: Foresight
active.description: You can try to glimpse into an event in the future; you might get an idea, a few images or a voice that will warn you about the event/its outcome; attempting to use foresight more than once on the same event will cause unknown effects.

passive.name: Spectral Regeneration
passive.description: Every hour spent in spectral form will regenerate 20% of your total HP and energy; you can also find special items there; you might encounter dormant creatures that will attack you.

modification.name: Spectral Senses
modification.description: While you are in spectral form you can see and sense things beyond the mortals' eyes and senses.

additionalTalents.name: Inconspicuous Trespasser
additionalTalents.description: For every hour spent in the mortal plane, you can spend the same amount in spectral form without changing the aspect of your body to others.

additionalTalents.name: Hunter's Instinct
additionalTalents.description: When your character would roll a secret WIS check (insight or other WIS check the DM rolls), your character will get a hunch of how on point their instinct was.

phantom.name: Chronomaster
phantom.lore: Phantoms who master time through the spectral realm.

active.name: Time Travel
active.description: You go to a point in time (past or future); you cannot interact with anything, only observe; you are automatically teleported to the same spatial point; the future is based on current actions; you can remain for 1 minute at most; you cannot teleport to the same year more than once.

passive.name: Ageless
passive.description: You become immune to aging and age altering effects; you can also appear as young or old as you desire (changeable after one hour ritual).

modification.name: Stance Enhancement
modification.description: Your stances now have undetermined duration (you can end them early or switch to another stance with no penalty, and remain in a stance for as long as you want).

additionalTalents.name: Time Blink
additionalTalents.description: Whenever you enter spectral form you can choose to go back in time a turn, returning to the position where you were at the end of your last turn.

additionalTalents.name: Time Skip
additionalTalents.description: Whenever you would gain exhaustion, you can ignore it for 24 hours, after which you gain 2 stacks instead; whenever you would gain a negative effect, you can delay it for a turn but can no longer roll to end it at end of each turn.

striker.name: Order of Knowledge
striker.lore: This order believes that knowledge is the ultimate goal, and seeks to uncover and preserve as much as possible; they use magic wells to seal away information and knowledge.

active.name: Perfect Recall
active.description: You instantly remember one information even if sealed by magic; you can also try to find information you don't possess - if it is found in the world, you know the location of the nearest knowledge well possessing that information.

passive.name: Knowledge Shield
passive.description: You have advantage and are proficient in all saving throws that would alter your memory; additionally you instantly uncover 3 random abilities or stats of every known/studied opponent.

modification.name: Mana Barrier Enhancement
modification.description: While Mana Barrier is active you have advantage on saving throws against spells, but that drains 50 mana (you can choose whether to activate this additional feat).

additionalTalents.name: Rejuvenation of the Wise
additionalTalents.description: When drinking from a well of knowledge you regain 50% HP, 100% mana and all cooldowns; all negative effects lesser than a cut limb, terminal disease or major curse are removed.

additionalTalents.name: Knowledge from Beyond
additionalTalents.description: You are able to access the memories of the dead to seek and preserve knowledge; only knowledge that they didn't wish hidden can be accessed.

striker.name: Order of the Seekers
striker.lore: This order knows of secret locuses of magic scattered throughout the universe from the very beginning.

active.name: Locus Power
active.description: For 3 turns your INT modifier is increased by the number of magic locuses you've uncovered.

passive.name: Locus Sensing
passive.description: You can sense locuses of magic within 300 ft; after interacting with one, you learn one spell from any battlemage subclass, and permanently increase mana by 30.

modification.name: Mana Rush Enhancement
modification.description: You can also expend 15 * spell level mana to halve the AP cost (rounded up) of any kind of spell you cast.

additionalTalents.name: Rebirth of the Seeker
additionalTalents.description: When you die you can choose to lose 2 stat points in a random stat (chosen by rolling 1d7 AFTER choosing to use this feat).

additionalTalents.name: Persuasive
additionalTalents.description: You can use the number of locuses of magic uncovered instead of your CHA modifier for any persuasion check.

striker.name: Order of the Blade
striker.lore: This order believes in the power of a weapon and a warrior's connection to it; they see magic as a way to enhance this connection.

active.name: Soulbound Weapon
active.description: You soulbound with a weapon; it cannot be wielded by anyone else; you cannot be disarmed; choose 2 spells that permanently affect the weapon (summed spell level cannot exceed 4); you can soulbound 2 light weapons instead and split the levels. Roll 1d20 daily; on 20 regain this active.

passive.name: Magic Weapon
passive.description: Soulbound weapons are considered magic for the purpose of overcoming resistances.

modification.name: Relentless Assault - Steel Variant
modification.description: You can choose to convert all damage you deal to physical for the 3 attacks, but they all do full weapon damage (all effects converted to physical damage too).

additionalTalents.name: Once for All
additionalTalents.description: You increase your STR and CON by 2; using your active on a new weapon removes this buff.

additionalTalents.name: Power Transfer
additionalTalents.description: You can transfer one particularity of a weapon to another one (the bonus to attack, the damage, the unique effect, etc.); a weapon can only have one unique effect; does not apply to spellcaster weapons.

battlecaster.name: Angel of Pain
battlecaster.lore: Battlecasters who draw power from self-inflicted damage.

active.name: Death Brace
active.description: If you die before your next turn, spend one round dead then respawn with 50% HP and 50% mana (keeping all stored energy); if you survive until your next turn, you fall dead and fight death (bypassing similar effects).

passive.name: Energy Storage
passive.description: Whenever you deal damage to yourself with a spell you store that amount as energy; while you have at least 50% max HP stored energy, spells that would damage you heal you instead (but still store); arcane veins heals an additional time; energy isn't stored while arcane veins is active.

modification.name: Self-Target + Energy Spend
modification.description: You can make any spell you cast have you as an eligible target; additionally, expend any amount of stored energy to deal bonus damage with any spell that damages you too.

additionalTalents.name: True Magic
additionalTalents.description: If a spell would deal three times an enemy's MA (before damage reduction) it ignores their MA entirely.

additionalTalents.name: Cut Down
additionalTalents.description: You roll max damage dice values for any attack and spell if your HP is lower than your opponent's current HP.

battlecaster.name: Energy Demon
battlecaster.lore: Battlecasters who push AP to extreme limits.

active.name: AP Charge
active.description: You become stunned for up to 3 turns (you decide duration at cast); at the end of each turn of this effect, your maximum AP is increased by 5 for the rest of combat.

passive.name: AP to Defense
passive.description: Any AP that you do not spend by the end of the turn will increase your AC and saving throws by +1 (for each AP saved) for the upcoming round.

modification.name: Mass Destruction Enhancement
modification.description: Mass Destruction damage is quadrupled if triggered while you are at full AP.

additionalTalents.name: Hostile Overload
additionalTalents.description: Your AP recovery is increased by 1 for every enemy beyond the first (at least 2 opponents) within 10 ft of you.

additionalTalents.name: Patient Resilience
additionalTalents.description: If you end your turn with 6 or more AP, you become resistant to all types of damage (except true) for one round.

battlecaster.name: Stone Titan
battlecaster.lore: Battlecasters who focus on tanking and drawing enemy attention.

active.name: Taunt
active.description: You taunt all enemy creatures within 15 ft of you; at the end of each of their turns, affected creatures must succeed on a WIS saving throw to end the effect.

passive.name: Proximity Armor
passive.description: Your PA and MA are increased by your level for each opponent beyond the first (at least 2) within 10 ft of you.

modification.name: Comeback of the Arcanist Enhancement
modification.description: You are immune for one round after using it.

additionalTalents.name: Fair Fight
additionalTalents.description: You are immune from the effects of flanking.

additionalTalents.name: Walk It Off
additionalTalents.description: Your AC is increased by 2 for every negative effect affecting you.

inquisitor.name: Guard Chief
inquisitor.lore: Inquisitors who serve as leaders of military forces.

active.name: Mass Root
active.description: You root all opponents within 60 ft for 3 turns; CON saving throw AT THE END of each turn to end it.

passive.name: Underdog Power
passive.description: When fighting an opponent stronger than you (your party is expected to lose based on avg level vs enemy might) you double your PA, MA and STR modifier.

modification.name: Keen's Mind Enhancement
modification.description: Also applied to intimidation and insight checks while interrogating a target.

additionalTalents.name: Forced Surrender
additionalTalents.description: Once per long rest you can have a successful die fail instead (not the other way around, cannot make a failed attack succeed).

additionalTalents.name: Hostage Protection
additionalTalents.description: Innocent creatures (not taking part in combat and haven't been) are immune while within 100 ft of you.

inquisitor.name: Executioner
inquisitor.lore: Inquisitors who specialize in eliminating targets, especially wounded ones.

active.name: Finishing Blow
active.description: You make your next attack deal 1 bonus damage for every 20 HP missing from the target.

passive.name: Advantage on Wounded
passive.description: You reroll any natural failures (1 on attack rolls) against injured targets; furthermore, you attack with advantage on severely injured targets.

modification.name: Lasting Punishment Enhancement
modification.description: You add twice the amount of stacks on injured targets, and 4 times the normal amount on severely injured targets.

additionalTalents.name: Death of the Weak
additionalTalents.description: When both you and a target are severely injured, you can use this talent to do a resolve contest; the loser dies instantly; once per long rest.

additionalTalents.name: Scent of Death
additionalTalents.description: After you kill a creature, you restore 50% of your max HP.

inquisitor.name: Lone Destroyer
inquisitor.lore: Some inquisitors go on long and vicious missions by themselves; they toughen up but are not particularly good at fighting alongside others.

active.name: Lone Strength
active.description: You gain temporary HP equal to 50% of your max HP for each opponent within 60 ft; the temporary HP is lost at the end of combat.

passive.name: Solo Fighter
passive.description: While fighting alone, your maximum HP and mana are doubled, and your maximum AP becomes 15, and starting and recovery AP become 10.

modification.name: Lasting Punishment/Reflective Shield Enhancement
modification.description: While fighting alone, you put double the amount of Lasting Punishment stacks, and you do double damage with Reflective Shield.

additionalTalents.name: Double Trouble
additionalTalents.description: Your effects remain even while you have one ally fighting by your side.

additionalTalents.name: Tireless Efforts
additionalTalents.description: You gain stacks of exhaustion twice as hard (2 sleepless nights, 2 days without eating, etc.).
